#1. BYD admits wheel assembly error on its flagship electric SUV

📅 13 Nov 2026

BYD admits wheel assembly error on its flagship electric SUV

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.engadget.com/2315638/byd-wheel-assembly-error-great-tang-electric-suv/

Some Great Tang SUVs had their wheels installed the wrong way.

Diungkapkan bahwa byd has apologized for an assembly mistake affecting some units of its newly released great tang — or datang, as it's called in china — electric suv. According to Bloomberg, several owners complained that the wider wheel rims that were supposed to be installed on the rear of the vehicle were installed on the front. Meanwhile, the narrower wheel rims for the front of the car were installed on the back instead.

Berdasarkan laporan, the chinese electric automaker has posted its apology on social network weibo, explaining that it launched an investigation after getting complaints from owners. Apparently, it traced the problem to its Hubei-based wheel mesh assembly supplier. BYD said it has already fixed the issue, and the supplier has also added a visual inspection mechanism on the production line, so that future vehicles will no longer be affected.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, byd didn't say how many vehicles were affected by the assembly error, but it said that there was no safety risk associated with the wheels being installed the wrong way. Even so, it will replace the wheel rims of the those vehicles for free and will also offer their owners a replacement vehicle or compensation for what they will spend on transportation while their Great Tang SUVs are being repaired. In addition, the company will restart their vehicle's warranty period.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the company unveiled the great tang suv in march, with prices starting at around $40,000. It received 150,000 orders in its home country. BYD is planning to release the electric vehicle in European and Asian markets outside China by the end of this year or in early 2027.

#4. Meta's Muse can now make calls on your behalf (if you have a paid subscription)

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.engadget.com/2315525/metas-muse-can-now-make-calls-on-your-behalf-if-you-have-a-paid-subscription/

The AI agent can schedule appointments, make reservations and wait on hold for you.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, meta's muse just got another ability that could make the ai agent feel a little bit more like an actual personal assistant. Muse is now able to place phone calls on your behalf, if you have a paid subscription.

Diungkapkan bahwa with the change, muse is able to call businesses to help with tasks like making reservations, scheduling appointments and other "calls you don't want to make," meta's chief ai officer alexandr wang said in an update. The feature is available to those who have paid for a separate Muse subscription, which comes with additional tokens and some extra features.

Sebagaimana diketahui, some users who have had access to the feature already have reported that muse has been able to handle phone-related tasks with relative ease. Moltbook creator and Meta Superintelligence employee Matt Schlicht shared a recreation of a phone conversation his agent had with a Volvo dealership last month, noting that it was able to wait on hold in order to get the info he needed.

My muse called Volvo for me to see when the next available appointment is.

I have it do multiple calls like this every day (I'm still trying to get better and better at leveraging muse).

Sebagaimana diketahui, my muse called, waited on the line for 15 minutes,. pic. twitter. com/bosH1tyW1R.

— Matt Schlicht (@MattPRD) October 9, 2026.

Berdasarkan laporan, interestingly, in the call shared by schlicht, muse doesn't explicitly identify itself as an ai agent though it notes it's calling his behalf and that it's transcribing the call. That may be enough for some straightforward tasks, but there's always a chance these types of calls could go off the rails or the person on the other end hangs up when they realize they're speaking with an AI.

Berdasarkan laporan, meta has been steadily churning out new features for muse, which has already drawn more than 10 million users, according to the company. People can also now assign a dedicated email address to their agent in order to loop it into important emails without giving wholesale access to their inbox.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the company isn't the first to experiment with phone-calling abilities for ai. Google has introduced a number of similar features over the years, including "Call For Me" for Pixel phones and Instinct recently introduced a "Concierge" feature for its agent that's meant to handle more complex calls.

#5. Disney's 'Star Wars' is coming to Cosm domes ahead of 50th anniversary as part of multiyear film deal

📅 12 Nov 2026

Disney's 'Star Wars' is coming to Cosm domes ahead of 50th anniversary as part of multiyear film deal

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/12/star-wars-cosm-dome-screenings.html

Berdasarkan laporan, on thursday, the immersive entertainment technology company announced a new studio partnership with the walt disney co. that will bring the original "Star Wars" to its domes early next year as part of a multiyear, multifilm collaboration.

The financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Cosm's massive concave screens will drop film fans into a galaxy far, far away starting in March, just ahead of the Academy Award-winning film's 50th anniversary in May.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we are thrilled to add the disney partnership," alexis scalice, head of cosm studios, told cnbc. We look for those opportunities to celebrate with the fans, but also find this mutually beneficial partnership between both parties. "We do look for those opportunities of these like anniversary and commemorative moments. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, this will be cosm's sixth theatrical collaboration with hollywood, having already partnered with warner bros. to bring "The Matrix," "Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory," "Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone" and "It" to its locations. The company is set to launch immersive screenings of Universal's "Shrek" in December.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, each cosm dome has stadium-style seating, with booths and tables set on each level. The dome's width fills much of the viewers' periphery, giving the sensation that they are part of the onscreen environment.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this case, "star wars" will be displayed in a large rectangle in the center of the dome while the background is transformed into the iconic planets of tatooine and yavin iv that are featured in the film as well as the infamous death star. Audiences will also see elements that will make it appear like they're traveling at lightspeed and getting trapped in an intergalactic trash compactor.

Cosm is working directly with studios Lucasfilm and Industrial Light and Magic as well as creative studio MakeMake to create the visuals and the sound mixing for the unique presentation of the film.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we look for those moments where sound, music. you feel those moments differently in an 87-foot diameter dome and 12k resolution with the sound system we have," Scalice said. "And it's one of the things that with experiential cinema and our technology that we were so excited and honestly privileged that we can take these defining moments for fans and work closely with our partners that doesn't really change the authenticity of it, it just enhances it in a different manner. listening to Darth Vader's breath for the first time. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the premium experience will also be paired with a themed menu. Cosm has done this with other titles, such as "Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone," serving guests throughout the screening with house-made shepherd's pie, pretzel wands with cheese dip and a box of Bertie Bott's Every Flavour Beans.

Berdasarkan laporan, cosm is trying to establish itself as a destination for fandom — both for sports and for film. It has a wide variety of live event offerings, which it telecasts using proprietary cameras mounted in arenas that broadcast back to the dome, as well as its expanding library of movies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "what i love is that we really are kind of building these cosm communities built on fandom," scalice said. "It's the No. 1 foundation for our business. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa and star wars is a powerful fandom. The franchise remains one of the top-ranking pieces of intellectual property across film, television and retail annually, and Disney is gearing up for a massive celebration of its semicentennial including merchandise launches, theatrical re-releases, its biannual Star Wars Celebration convention and collaborations with other brands.

#6. Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility

📅 12 Nov 2026

Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/11/12/1148483/nvidia-chip-tracking/

The Chip Security Act is getting renewed attention following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation and reported affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

Diungkapkan bahwa representatives from nvidia told illinois representative bill foster that it would be technically possible to implement the anti-smuggling measures called for in the chip security act, foster told mit technology review in an interview on thursday, even while an industry group claimed they were “potentially infeasible. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa foster, a democrat who serves on the committee on science, space, and technology, is a cosponsor of the act, which would introduce geotracking requirements to verify the location of advanced ai chips in order to prevent their smuggling to china. It is one of three chip-security bills under consideration for inclusion in the Senate’s National Defense Authorization Act, each of which is drawing renewed attention after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s resignation and reported affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, when the chip security act was introduced, in may 2025, lawmakers said the technology to implement it existed, something nvidia has not publicly confirmed. In March 2026, the Semiconductor Industry Association, of which Nvidia is a member, explicitly opposed the bill and wrote that its mandates for chip tracking were “new, untested, and potentially infeasible. ”.

But privately, Nvidia representatives working with Foster told the lawmaker that the company could implement them.

Diungkapkan bahwa “they never put anything in writing,” foster says, but during technical discussions on the possibility of such safeguards, their reaction was “yeah, of course we can do this. ” This private acknowledgment to Foster goes further than anything Nvidia has previously made public.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, other technology nvidia has built for its customers suggests that the company can indeed offer accurate tracking of its chips’ locations. In December 2025, for example, it announced a new tool called Fleet Intelligence that would allow customers to monitor how its advanced chips were performing across different data center locations. In doing so, the tool could indicate which country chips were in, Nvidia confirmed to Reuters, but the company would not elaborate on whether this technology could be used to prevent smuggling.

Nvidia did not respond to requests for comment or confirmation of Foster’s characterization.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in early october, when lawmakers were reportedly increasingly concerned about nvidia’s role in smuggling, mit technology review asked the company if fleet intelligence could be used to prevent the practice. It declined to answer directly, instead sending a statement: “Governments and media have found insignificant diversion of controlled US products—a drop in the bucket compared to the ocean of domestic compute China already has. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the recent fallout at nvidia involves a number of people and companies alleged to be involved in chip smuggling. A US Commerce Department inquiry into the company was reportedly halted after invention by Nvidia. Alice Huang, with whom Jensen Huang reportedly had an affair, runs Megaspeed, a Singaporean firm now under investigation for smuggling advanced GPUs to China. Megaspeed reportedly bought chips from Supermicro, a company that packages Nvidia’s chips onto servers.

Diungkapkan bahwa the chip security act as drafted would require a mechanism to track the locations of chips, either by inspections of facilities, attestations by companies, or ping-based location mechanisms. The ping-based technique, the hardest option to circumvent, would require the GPU to send a signal of its location when it comes online. In September, the Center for Security and Emerging Technology found it would be the most cost-effective option.

Foster said he did not ask Nvidia’s representatives why they weren’t voluntarily adopting such chip-tracking tools if they could technically do so.

Berdasarkan laporan, but if the requirements of the bill pass as part of the senate’s national defense authorization act, the new tracking mechanisms would only tell investigators where the chips are, not offer a way to disconnect them if it’s revealed they have been smuggled. Foster told MIT Technology Review he intends to introduce new, stricter legislation in the new year that would offer a workaround. The new rule would require licenses to operate advanced GPUs, and before a GPU could connect, its valid license would need to be verified.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in the meantime, the controversy at nvidia, foster says, has fueled support among his colleagues for the rules in the bill: “there will be a lot of political pressure, in the wake of everything that’s happened, on the companies to actually do a very good job of the geographic validation of where the chip actually is. ”.

#7. Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay

📅 12 Nov 2026

Muse can now place calls to US businesses — if you pay

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/muse-can-now-place-calls-to-u-s-businesses-if-you-pay/

Berdasarkan laporan, meta’s muse, which now has over 10 million users, the company said last month, has been working to make consumer ai a mainstream product for everyday users. Placing calls is one of the ways it aims to get there, as it could handle another task on people’s to-do lists.

Notes Alexandr Wang, Meta’s chief AI officer and head of its Superintelligence Labs division, the feature could be used to take care of calls people don’t want to make, like those to their cable company, the DMV, or to a restaurant that doesn’t offer online reservations.

Diungkapkan bahwa 🚨muse feature alert!!!🚨lots of you have been asking for this one…muse can make phone calls for you! ☎️📞📲let muse take care of all those calls you don’t want to make. insurance? cable? DMV? dinner res? not your problem anymore. twitter. out now to paid subs in the US 🇺🇸 pic. com/dsyMNmI2Ub.

Diungkapkan bahwa previously, only a select number of muse early adopters were able to try this feature after asking the ai for access. Currently, Muse subscription plans start at $20 per month for 500 million Muse tokens per week. Now, anyone who pays for Muse can make this type of request. Heavier AI users can opt to pay $100 per month for 3 billion tokens.

Sebagaimana diketahui, muse is not the only ai agent able to place calls to businesses; the startup instinct has been offering a similar option, as has google’s gemini. Many businesses and receptionists hang up on calls from AI agents as soon as they identify that it’s not a human on the phone. However, while the AI tools are now certainly capable of handling the task, the reception on the other end of the line can be mixed. But with AI now better able to mimic a real human voice, being able to tell the difference between a customer and an AI working on the customer’s behalf will get tougher.

Berdasarkan laporan, despite the challenges, this feature is one that could appeal to consumers who have grown frustrated with the state of customer service over the years. If they’re lucky, that person can actually help them, and not transfer them to another department. For too long, customers have been forced to navigate complex phone trees, and then sit on hold waiting for a human representative to pick up. Now, those consumers could potentially use their AI, with its infinite patience, for this tedious task instead.

While calls remain a paid-only feature for the time being, the recently added option to make a Muse email address will soon roll out to free users, Wang said this week.

#9. Who is Collette Kress, NVIDIA's interim CEO?

📅 12 Nov 2026

Who is Collette Kress, NVIDIA's interim CEO?

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.engadget.com/2315274/who-is-collette-kress-nvidia-ceo/

Kress spent 25 years in various finance roles before joining NVIDIA in 2013.

Diungkapkan bahwa after 33 years as the chief executive officer of nvidia, jensen huang has resigned from the ai and gaming giant he founded. On Thursday morning, the company's board of director announced Colette Kress, NVIDIA's current executive vice president and chief financial officer, as Huang's temporary replacement.

"The Board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team, and we expect the company's operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption," newly-minted NVIDIA board chair Harvey Jones said in a release announcing Thursday's news.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, kress is a relative unknown, but is taking lead of nvidia at tumultuous time in the company's history. Before the revelations, the company did not have a succession plan in place. Huang departure comes days after NVIDIA's board said it would investigate Huang after he admitted to having an affair with a former tech executive accused of being a Chinese intelligence asset. And for at least the immediate future, it's now on Kress to lead the company. The New York Times later reported that Huang had also had an affair with an NVIDIA executive who reported to him. Here's what we know about the executive.

Berdasarkan laporan, kress worked at three companies before joining nvidia. #10. In reversal, American Cancer Society urges routine prostate cancer screening

📅 12 Nov 2026

In reversal, American Cancer Society urges routine prostate cancer screening

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/health/2026/11/in-reversal-american-cancer-society-urges-prostate-cancer-tests-for-all-men/

Men aged 50–69 and at average risk should get PSA screening every two years.

In a significant update to its guidelines for prostate cancer screening, the American Cancer Society is now recommending that men get routinely screened for prostate cancer with a PSA test.

Men at average risk should get a PSA test every two years from age 50 to 69, according to the new guidelines released Thursday.

Diungkapkan bahwa men considered at high risk due to race and family history should start testing earlier, at 45, and most are recommended to get tested every year. Specifically, yearly testing starting at age 45 is recommended for all Black men, who have higher rates of prostate cancer. Non-Black men should also get yearly testing starting at 45 if a close relative was diagnosed with prostate cancer before age 65, or if more than one of their relatives has had prostate cancer. On the other hand, if only one close relative was diagnosed with prostate cancer and it was diagnosed at age 65 or older, non-Black men in this case should start PSA screening at 45, but are recommended to get testing only every two years.

Men ages 70 to 74 should consult their doctor on continuing screening, while those 75 and up are not recommended to get screened.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the new guidance departs from acs’s previous iteration, published in 2010, which made no universal recommendations for routine screening. and new members are reportedly rife with conflicts of interest. (The USPSTF is currently working on an update to its prostate cancer screening recommendation, though it should be noted that the panel has recently been overhauled by anti-vaccine Health Secretary Robert F. The recommendation was similar to that from the US Preventive Services Task Force, a federal panel that regularly evaluates evidence and makes recommendations on such preventive medical care. Men at age 50 were recommended to use shared-decision making with their doctors on whether or not to get tested. Kennedy Jr. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in announcing the guidelines today, the acs says its updates are based on new evidence since 2010 that shows screening saves lives, and that advances in case management can avoid the concerning harms from overdiagnosis and overtreatment. For many men with prostate cancer, their cancer will never grow or cause harm in their lifetime, while treatment can run the risk of erectile dysfunction and urinary incontinence.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the new guidance, the acs adds guardrails, firstly advising all men to be informed about the risks and benefits. If a PSA test comes back high—defined as 3 ng/mL or higher for men under 70 and 6. 5 ng/mL or higher for those 70 and up—the ACS recommends repeating the test before taking any next steps.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if repeat testing is still high, then men should get either a prostate mri or a validated biomarker test to assess risk. Only if there is a high suspicion of cancer—such as having a very high PSA test result—should men jump to a prostate biopsy.

For men diagnosed with prostate cancer, active surveillance should be the initial management strategy for men whose cancer appears to be at low risk of growing or spreading.

Berdasarkan laporan, “by catching aggressive cancers with a simple psa blood test, you open the door to highly effective treatments that protect your future,” dr. Shanthi Sivendran, interim chief patient officer for the ACS, said in a statement. “Meanwhile, lower-risk findings can be safely managed through careful, active surveillance. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers in men and the second leading cause of cancer death in us men, the acs notes. Nearly 334,00 men are estimated to be diagnosed with prostate cancer in 2026, and it’s estimated that over 36,320 will die from the disease.

#14. The Hubble Space Telescope Is Sinking. NASA Is Looking for Ways to Keep It Afloat

📅 13 Nov 2026

The Hubble Space Telescope Is Sinking. NASA Is Looking for Ways to Keep It Afloat

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/nasa-wants-to-keep-the-hubble-space-telescope-afloat/

Diungkapkan bahwa as telescopes go, few if any are more famous than the hubble space telescope. Over 30 years of operations, the telescope has been essential to groundbreaking discoveries that have fundamentally transformed humanity’s view of the universe. But like all satellites in low Earth orbit, it’s been gradually descending.

Diungkapkan bahwa this happens because of atmospheric drag, and the hubble space telescope is not equipped with a propulsion system to adjust its own orbit. According to NASA’s analysis, if left unchecked, the telescope will likely re-enter Earth’s atmosphere in 2033 or 2034, eventually crashing back onto the planet.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, hoping to delay this conclusion, nasa has issued a formal request for information seeking proposals from the private sector for “in-space servicing” of the famous telescope. This would likely involve raising Hubble’s altitude to extend its operational lifespan, but the agency is also open to industry’s suggestions for managing a safe and controlled reentry or disposal of the telescope while still in orbit. Space companies can also propose upgrades to enhance the telescope’s functionality in its remaining years.

Diungkapkan bahwa “hubble is a national icon,” nicky fox, associate administrator of nasa's science mission directorate, said in a statement. “Given the time we have until Hubble’s anticipated reentry, we are eager to explore the breadth of possibilities to boost Hubble to a higher orbit while we develop the flagship mission to follow. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the telescope was designed with the expectation that astronauts would perform repairs and upgrades in orbit. The last of these missions was canceled after the space shuttle Columbia disaster in 2003. Since it was launched in 1990, a total of five service missions have been carried out. But NASA later determined that the benefits of servicing Hubble outweighed the risks of a final mission, and in 2009 a crew took measures, such as replacing the battery, to extend the telescope’s lifespan.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is also not the first time nasa has considered private-sector resources for raising the hubble space telescope’s orbit. In September 2022, NASA entered into a nonfunding partnership agreement with SpaceX to investigate the possibility of using the company’s Dragon spacecraft to move Hubble into a more stable orbit. However, according to NASA’s announcement at the time, the agency had no plans to conduct or fund the service mission itself; the study was intended solely to assess commercial feasibility.

Berdasarkan laporan, meanwhile, nasa commissioned the private company katalyst space technologies in september 2025 to perform an orbital raise for the swift observatory, which was experiencing faster-than-expected orbital decay. However, the company’s spacecraft, launched in July 2026, suffered an attitude control malfunction, forcing the mission to be abandoned. On November 4, Swift reentered the atmosphere over Indonesia.

Diungkapkan bahwa the problems facing the hubble space telescope are not limited to its drop in altitude. The spacecraft itself is also experiencing malfunctions. In June 2024, NASA announced that it would transition the Hubble Space Telescope to a new operating mode using only one of the six gyros on board to assess the telescope’s orientation. After more than three decades in space, only three of the gyros were operational, and one of those was starting to return abnormal readings. The other remaining functional gyro is now being kept in a ready state for future use.

Berdasarkan laporan, nasa estimates that a mission to raise the telescope’s orbit will need to be carried out by 2032. In an announcement made in 2022, NASA also explained that if the Hubble Space Telescope could be raised to a higher, more stable orbit, it could continue to observe the cosmos for several more years.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “hubble still has important science ahead of it, and we should be looking at every reasonable opportunity to keep it delivering for as long as possible,” said nasa administrator jared isaacman. Extending Hubble’s life would mean more discoveries, more science, and more opportunities to expand our understanding of the universe. “If there are innovative and cost-effective ways to extend the life of an asset already in orbit, we owe it to the American taxpayer and the scientific community to explore them. ”.

#17. FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace

FAA expands AI advice to manage air traffic congestion across entire US airspace

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/11/faa-expands-ai-advice-to-manage-air-traffic-congestion-across-entire-us-airspace/

Airlines praised the AI tool, but the air traffic controllers’ union wasn’t involved.

Diungkapkan bahwa the us government has expanded the use of an ai tool for advising air traffic controllers to assist in managing air traffic across the entire national airspace system. Airline executives have voiced support for the rollout, but the US labor union representing air traffic controllers has said it was not involved in designing or testing the AI-driven system.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the federal aviation administration (faa) says the $875 million smart system has helped reroute 180 flights since being implemented in airspace over washington, dc, on september 21. The agency claims that this saved an average of 10 minutes per flight and almost 80 gallons of fuel per flight—and it is apparently hoping such results can be replicated nationwide through the expanded deployment.

“After a successful initial rollout to the National Capital Region in September, the FAA will now use SMART in the airspace of all 22 centers across the country to reduce delays, reduce fuel consumption and improve the travel experience for the flying public,” according to the agency statement posted on November 10.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the faa fact sheet describes smart as a cloud-based system that combines information about “weather patterns, flight paths, traffic flow and controller staffing metrics” to predict air traffic patterns. It is designed to make scheduling recommendations, identify optimal flight routes, and determine the best order of arrivals for aircraft.

However, a human team of FAA specialists based in DC is ultimately responsible for validating the SMART system recommendations before passing them along to air traffic control facilities across the country, according to the agency.

Sebagaimana diketahui, furthermore, the ai-powered smart system “cannot be used to replace the critical role air traffic controllers play or take over control of an aircraft,” the faa clarified in the september 21 announcement about the initial deployment. Local air traffic controllers can decide whether or not to accept the SMART system recommendations.

The previous FAA announcement included supportive statements from Delta Air Lines CEO Ed Bastian and American Airlines CEO Robert Isom.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the national air traffic controllers association, which represents more than 15,000 members, also told flying magazine that it was not consulted or involved in the “design, testing, or implementation of smart and therefore cannot speak to its effect on the air traffic control workforce. ”.

Following the initial deployment in airspace above DC, the FAA expanded the SMART system’s coverage to air route traffic control centers in Atlanta along with Jacksonville and Miami in Florida, according to The Dallas Morning News.

The FAA also shared an example with The Dallas Morning News about how SMART recommended a shorter and faster route for a cargo flight arriving at Dallas-Fort Worth International Airport, although the newspaper noted that the agency did not identify the flight involved and has not provided information about how SMART may have assisted passenger flight traffic.

Ars has previously covered the SMART system’s development and lingering questions about how it works, as well as the air traffic controller shortage and other challenges facing the FAA.

Diungkapkan bahwa jensen huang might have stepped down from his roles at the top of nvidia, but he won't be sliding out of the spotlight just yet. The company's former CEO and president is set to testify before Congress by Thanksgiving, according to House representatives.

Berdasarkan laporan, house foreign affairs chairman brian mast said huang agreed to testify on wednesday — hours before nvidia announced his resignation with immediate effect — after lawmakers threatened him with a subpoena. It appears the hearing will take place behind closed doors (which is unfortunate, because that's likely to be some spicy testimony). However, Mast expects it to be filmed and transcribed, according to Bloomberg. The House's Intelligence and China-focused committees will join the Foreign Affairs cohort for the hearing.

It comes three weeks after Ukraine’s speeds were restored following the last throttling incident.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as media headlines focus on jensen huang's resignation and the midterms fallout, you could almost forget that ukraine is still fighting for its life — with all of europe nervously watching. The country's access to Starshield, the military version of Starlink, has been hit with "systematic speed restrictions" for several days. According to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, his job just got harder again. And it just so happens to be while Trump's envoys are in Moscow for talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin.

Diungkapkan bahwa zelenskyy posted on x that the speed limits are being imposed along the war's entire front line and in russian-occupied territory. He said any terminal moving faster than 161 km/h (100 mph) loses its connection to the satellite network. Following briefings from his defense minister and top commander, Zelenskyy said Ukraine's military had investigated and ruled out random errors.

Berdasarkan laporan, "unfortunately, this is helping the russians kill more ukrainians and carry out more accurate strikes against ukraine," zelenskyy said. "We are trying to establish all the circumstances with the American side. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, ukraine's interceptor drones rely on starshield to chase down russia's jet-powered shahed drones, which can fly up to 500 km/h (310 mph). Trying to catch them at 100 mph won't cut it. Zelenskyy says some strikes have already gotten through because Ukraine's interceptors couldn't go fast enough.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the timing is. US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner landed in Moscow today for talks with Putin. curious. They're expected to meet Zelenskyy later at a summit in Ireland.

Berdasarkan laporan, this isn't the first time ukraine's starshield access has been throttled. It happened as President Trump was publicly complaining about Ukraine's strikes on Russian refineries, which he blamed for high fuel prices in the US ahead of the midterms. On October 14, Ukraine's military found that its speeds were being limited to around the same threshold. Analysts agree that Trump's war with Iran has been the biggest factor in sky-high oil and diesel prices.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it still isn't clear who made the call to throttle starshield the first time. But days later, the Wall Street Journal reported that Musk personally ordered the slowdown, possibly after talking with Trump. Reuters, citing US officials, reported that the order came from inside the White House. Trump denied any role, for whatever that's worth.

Berdasarkan laporan, musk's responses were all over the place. First, he said Starshield is "owned and controlled by the US government," then later claimed Ukraine had violated Starlink's terms of service. That's a strange thing to say about something you just said you don't own or control. Regardless, speeds were restored on October 24, reportedly after Trump called Musk and asked him to lift the caps amid bipartisan pressure from lawmakers.

Three weeks later, we're back where we started, with (so far) no one claiming responsibility.

#23. Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending

Nebius tests the neocloud playbook with $40 billion in planned spending

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/nebius-tests-the-neocloud-playbook-with-40-billion-in-planned-spending/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in its third-quarter earnings call thursday, the neocloud company nebius laid out $40 billion in planned spending for 2027, far more than wall street had expected. It’s an ambitious plan, but it rests on a string of planned projects that are already starting to show cracks.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nebius plans to fund the buildout by relying on customer pre-payments and loans backed by customer contracts — essentially using the future value of its data centers to finance their construction. But that can be a risky strategy if those projects get bogged down by delays or cancellations.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “building at this scale is hard, and delays are part of our industry right now,” ceo arkady volozh said during thursday’s earnings call. “We are not immune. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the earnings announcement comes on the heels of reports that microsoft is cooling on neocloud deals that aren’t delivering on time. That’s a problem for companies like Nebius, whose financing strategy is becoming more dependent on repayments. Because if it can’t get to capacity on time, it will keep piling on costs while revenues slip.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of nebius’ largest customers is microsoft, which is paying for ai computing capacity at a vineland, new jersey, data center that is now months behind schedule. Nebius’ contract with Microsoft is worth up to $19. 4 billion, but it’s already letting deadlines slip. Only just over half of the Microsoft capacity is now planned for delivery by the end of the year, with the rest coming in Q2 2027.

The delay is because DataOne, the third-party operator of the site, “decided to wind down the temporary generation faster than it was expected,” according to Andrey Korolenko, chief product and infrastructure officer, as the site switches over to Bloom Energy fuel cells.

Diungkapkan bahwa still, that transition wasn’t entirely by choice. In August, the investigative site Floodlight identified at least 45 natural gas generators in operation at the DataOne site, even though it had not received any permits for operating gas generators. New Jersey regulators fined the DataOne facility $1. 1 million in response, finding that the use of the generators violated federal law.

DataOne is also facing a noise-complaint lawsuit from nearby residents over a constant humming noise allegedly emitted by the data center.

Diungkapkan bahwa according to nebius’ summary of its microsoft contract, microsoft can terminate affected service after a grace period if dates are missed and no alternative capacity is offered. The tranches were originally meant to be deployed in 2025 and 2026, so a Q2 2027 delivery date falls well beyond that window. The contract also includes financial penalties for late delivery.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nebius said that microsoft “has been part of the planning process. ” Nebius did not say whether Microsoft has agreed to the new dates, but Microsoft has not publicly canceled anything.

TechCrunch has reached out to Nebius, Microsoft, and DataOne for comment.

Sebagaimana diketahui, on the call, marc boroditsky, nebius’s chief revenue officer, said the company’s deals with microsoft and meta both came with significant prepayment, which arrived long before delivery. But Bloomberg reported last week that Microsoft is tightening oversight on projects run by third parties, including Nebius, IREN, and Nscale, and debating whether it’s worth signing new agreements. Microsoft also sent employees to the site in New Jersey, per Bloomberg.

Berdasarkan laporan, in its own quarterly earnings report, microsoft noted that its capex spend was lower than expected due to third-party delays. The company is clearly not above pulling back from planned agreements where its partner doesn’t meet its share of the bargain. Bloomberg also reported that Microsoft won’t use an option to more than double its Nscale agreement for a Texas data center and recently stopped being an anchor customer for Nscale’s planned Essex site after power delays.

Sebagaimana diketahui, nebius says the delays it faces are coming from sites it doesn’t control, with the data centers it is building itself coming online on time or ahead of schedule. New deals signed in Q3 came with prepayments that more than cover the cost of building capacity behind them, says Boroditsky. Nebius ended the quarter with $7. Those, Nebius says, will supply most of its new capacity from 2027. 4 billion in cash.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, total prepayments plus asset-backed financing of investment-grade contracts are expected to cover up to 85% of the $40 to $45 billion 2027 capex spend. CFO Maria Del Dado Alonso Sanchez named Microsoft and Meta as contracts that can be financed this way. Boroditsky also said Nebius could “tap prepayments to shore up any additional cash requirements. ”.

Nebius forecast 2027 revenue of $12 to $13 billion, and said it expects to break even on a pre-tax basis by the fourth quarter.

Berdasarkan laporan, nebius reported third-quarter revenue of $981 million, up 571% from a year earlier. Roughly a third of that was a one-time payment tied to a new partnership model. Nebius cut its 2026 revenue forecast by $200 million to $3 billion, citing delays to third-party sites like New Jersey. Shares ended the day down 17%.

#24. Feds arrest top official of healthcare company, alleging illegal drug importation

📅 11 Nov 2026

Feds arrest top official of healthcare company, alleging illegal drug importation

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/11/canarx-official-arrested-drug-importation.html

Berdasarkan laporan, u. authorities are accusing the two top officials of a Canadian company of operating a long-running scheme to illegally import prescription drugs into the U. S. S. , according to court records filed Tuesday.

John Thomas Howard, treasurer and a director of the company, CANARX, was arrested Sunday on smuggling and conspiracy charges, according to the records.

Diungkapkan bahwa bob howard, his brother, who is president and a director of canarx, is also wanted in the federal investigation, according to an affidavit from dustin dobbs, a special agent with the food and drug administration's office of criminal investigations. He has not yet been taken into custody.

Berdasarkan laporan, besides conspiracy and smuggling, the arrest warrant said john thomas howard was charged with introducing misbranded drugs into interstate commerce and illegal drug importation. No plea has been filed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, canarx was featured in a cnbc investigation last year that revealed how the company and others known as alternative funding programs, or afps, are becoming more pervasive around the u. S. The investigation found these companies have penetrated the country's healthcare system by offering high-cost specialty drugs at more affordable prices through private and public employers. as drug costs skyrocket. In some cases, employers are requiring their staff to use an AFP.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, afps often obtain the medications overseas and ship them directly to patients, a practice that federal authorities have said is illegal and poses safety risks. CNBC traced the trail of drugs from abroad to the U. S. via a supply chain that the pharmaceutical companies producing the medications have not authorized.

Diungkapkan bahwa on its website, canarx, founded in 2002 and based in windsor, ontario, canada, described its business as the first international prescription provider for the u. and the safest such program in the industry. S. The company said it sources its medications from Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia and New Zealand.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but the affidavit said that the fda's investigation found "there is probable cause to believe that (canarx) illegally imported or caused the illegal importation of prescription drugs into the united states …. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the affidavit does not specify which medications the agency believes were illegally imported. The criminal complaint covers the period from Feb. 22, 2017, through April 15, 2026.

Berdasarkan laporan, the company's general counsel, joseph morris, told cnbc in a statement: "the howards deny all the charges against them, will defend vigorously, and expect to be vindicated in court. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa the company has been under fda scrutiny for several years. In 2023, the agency seized medication being shipped by CANARX that it says was potentially misbranded and counterfeit, according to an email sent to a patient that was obtained by CNBC.

Berdasarkan laporan, and in 2019, the fda sent a warning letter to the company, saying it was operating "in a manner that substitutes the fda-approved drugs prescribed by the u. S. healthcare provider with unapproved drugs. " Morris, in response to that warning, argued CANARX was not misleading patients, but agreed for the company to stop importing drugs that need to be administered by a doctor.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in an interview as part of the cnbc investigation, morris said last year that the medicines shipped to u. S. patients come from highly regulated countries. He said CANARX was operating legally.

Diungkapkan bahwa the central question for afps is the legality of importing prescription drugs into the u. for personal use. S. The FDA allows Americans to import medications for individual use in some cases if the drug is not available domestically. That is the basis on which the AFPs built their models for shipping medicines directly to patients.

Diungkapkan bahwa but an fda spokesperson told cnbc last year that "in most circumstances, a person cannot import prescription drugs from other countries into the u. S. as substitutes for FDA-approved drugs. ".

In a separate civil lawsuit that is pending, Gilead Sciences accused CANARX and other companies of illegally importing Biktarvy, its medication to treat HIV.

Berdasarkan laporan, in a statement to cnbc on wednesday, a gilead spokesperson said the company "has taken strong legal action to protect patients and the integrity of the u. We welcome the government's efforts to hold accountable those whose conduct may put patients at risk. S. medicines supply chain. ".

CANARX has not responded to the Gilead lawsuit.

#25. What to know about this year’s UN climate talks

📅 11 Nov 2026

What to know about this year’s UN climate talks

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/11/11/1148308/un-climate-talks/

Climate finance and fossil fuels top the formal agenda at COP31.

It’s that time of year again: Thousands of delegates, lobbyists, and journalists are gathered for the annual UN climate talks, taking place this time in Antalya, Turkey.

Berdasarkan laporan, cop31 officially kicked off on november 8, marking the beginning of negotiations on one of the biggest stages of the climate world. Turkey and Australia are cohosting this year’s talks, which are scheduled to wrap up on November 20.

Sebagaimana diketahui, this annual gathering can often serve as an indicator of where the world stands on addressing and adapting to the climate crisis. And this year’s talks are sure to be a doozy—expect a lot of back and forth on fossil fuels and climate finance in particular. Here’s what you should know about COP31.

Diungkapkan bahwa in recent years, the tension always feels high when cop rolls around. (COP stands for “Conference of the Parties. ”) But this year feels especially charged: The world is still grappling with the ongoing war in Iran, which has disrupted the Middle East and sent economic shock waves around the world as energy prices have spiked.

Diungkapkan bahwa this year’s cop will be the second without a formal delegation from the us. President Trump formally withdrew the country from the Paris Agreement earlier this year and is in the process of withdrawing from the UN Framework Committee on Climate Change. That’s the treaty that allows formal participation in negotiations.

Diungkapkan bahwa meanwhile, things aren’t looking good for the paris agreement, which was established at un climate talks 11 years ago, setting a goal of limiting warming to 1. 5 °C over preindustrial levels. 5 °C goal, “likely within the next few years. In a report published in September, the UN Environment Program acknowledged that global warming is set to exceed that 1. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, so as climate talks kick off, there’s an obvious, urgent question looming about how to quickly cut emissions to limit warming. There’s also the major issue of how to pay for efforts to address emissions and to help a warming world endure the inevitable damage.

Diungkapkan bahwa two years ago, talks ended in a goal of mobilizing $300 billion per year by 2035 to help pay to reduce emissions and adapt to climate change. 7 billion in 2024, according to the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development. (Rich nations provided $136. (Such funding has been quite flat over the past few years. ) And last year, the COP30 agreement included a goal of tripling the money for adaptation over that period. ).

Berdasarkan laporan, the world got a tragic reminder of just how high the stakes are earlier this year, when a glacier collapse caused devastating flooding in the himalayas. The flood killed approximately 1,500 people, left over 5,000 missing, and caused nearly $5 billion in damage. The UN loss and damages fund committed $20 million to helping Nepal recover (less than 1% of the total estimated cost to the country).

Berdasarkan laporan, another key trend to watch is how the formal negotiations engage with the topic of fossil fuels. But it felt as if things took a step back last year, when the final agreement didn’t even mention the phrase “fossil fuels” once. Three years ago, the final agreement text explicitly called for a transition away from them. This will be an interesting conversation, especially because cohosts Turkey and Australia have both faced criticism over their relationships with these fuels—Australia is a major exporter of coal and natural gas, and Turkey’s grid relies heavily on fossil fuels, including coal.

Sebagaimana diketahui, outside the formal negotiations, cop31 president murat kurum, turkey’s environment minister, is spearheading a side agenda, including two informal initiatives that will be worth watching. These wouldn’t be part of the official agreement text, but countries could sign on to signal support.

Berdasarkan laporan, one is a pledge to make ai more sustainable; this is almost comically squishy, even as voluntary cop pledges go. The text includes explicit wording that it creates no new obligations for countries, so don’t expect anything resembling enforcement there.

Berdasarkan laporan, the cop leadership is also pushing to make electricity a larger part of member countries’ energy use. Fossil fuels, like gasoline in vehicles or natural gas for heating, make up the bulk of the rest. Today, only about 23% of global energy is used in the form of electricity. Shifting to more electricity use, and relying on cleaner sources for that electricity, could help drive down emissions. The new pledge’s target is for electricity to make up 35% of total energy consumption by 2035.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, with leadership billing this as an “implementation cop,” it would be great to see some real, tangible progress on the global challenge of addressing climate change. I’m not expecting anything groundbreaking, but we’ll be tuned in to see what the final agreement shapes up to be.

Sebagaimana diketahui, drone and missile strikes have inflicted unprecedented damage on data centers in eastern europe and the middle east this year, disrupting cloud services for millions of people and permanently deleting some amazon web services customer data. This trend represents a new concern for Big Tech companies—but also for governments and everyone else who depends on common digital services in modern life.

Diungkapkan bahwa to explore what this all means for modern society’s reliance on cloud resilience, i will be hosting a live conversation titled “drone attacks and data centers: new risks for big tech” on tuesday, november 17 at 1 pm et with joseph jarnecki, a senior research fellow at the royal united services institute (rusi), a uk defense and security think tank. He leads RUSI’s work on how cloud services factor into national security and defense, along with tech sovereignty efforts.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, this year, jarnecki has written about iran’s drone and missile strikes on amazon data centers in the middle east during the us-israeli war with iran, and the broader implications for governments and big tech. For more background on the data center attacks that have transpired so far in 2026, you can see my previous Ars coverage of how the Iranian strikes left Amazon with months of repairs, and caused enough damage to result in the permanent loss of some AWS customer data.

I’ve also covered why Russia was not ready for the data center war it started with Ukraine, with the systematic Russian strike campaign targeting Ukraine’s data centers provoking Ukrainian counterstrikes that damaged Russian government data centers and AI data centers owned by the Russian tech giant Yandex.

My conversation with Jarnecki will explore why data centers have become much more prominent military targets, whether defending or hardening data centers against drones and missiles is a realistic option, how cloud resiliency can be improved in wartime conditions, and the choices governments and cloud providers face in deploying data centers during an era of growing geopolitical risks.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, you can watch the discussion live on youtube on november 17 at 1 pm et. We will also be fielding a few audience questions.

#32. Bitdefender Antivirus Plus Review: Undercutting the Competition

📅 13 Nov 2026

Bitdefender Antivirus Plus Review: Undercutting the Competition

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/review/bitdefender-antivirus-plus/

Antivirus programs are a dime a dozen these days, and while the vast array of security threats that assail modern devices can at times feel so overwhelming that protection seems impossible, a good antivirus solution remains essential.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unfortunately, purchasing an antivirus can prove rather confusing. If you dig deep enough into a company’s website, however, you’ll find that most still offer the option to purchase the antivirus with few add-ons at a lower price. Companies offer a huge range of bundles with long lists of features, many of which are obscured in vague language. And if that’s what you want, Bitdefender’s Antivirus Plus is a good option.

Diungkapkan bahwa buying bitdefender antivirus plus on its own is arguably a bit confusing, as the company strongly pushes shoppers toward more expensive and all-inclusive bitdefender bundles, which include other features like a password manager, dark web monitoring, and lots more. All these bundles include the same antivirus protection, but if you search for Antivirus Plus on its own, though, you will find it. There are also Family versions of these plans, which are more expensive but add protection for up to 25 devices and parental controls. In total, there are four different bundles to choose from: Total Security, Premium Security, Ultimate Security, and Ultimate Security Plus Extended, ranging from $60 up to $140 for the first year. And it’s arguably worth seeking out, as Bitdefender's entry-level options are priced most aggressively.

Diungkapkan bahwa bitdefender antivirus plus currently offers an introductory price of $25 for the first year (and $50 after) for a single device or $30 for the first year ($70 after) for three devices. This is quite a bit less than Bitdefender Total Security, which is $60 for the first year (and $110 after) and only offers two benefits in exchange: a password manager and protection for up to five devices instead of just one. The lower tiers tend to be better deals, especially if you're after something specific.

Sebagaimana diketahui, that’s because bitdefender’s pricing is most competitive at its lowest tiers, which may by itself be enough reason for many to choose it. Rivals like Norton Antivirus Standard, McAfee Essential, Avira Internet Security, and Malwarebytes Standard typically ask more for a similar level of service.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there is some variation here; norton throws in a password manager at a lower price point, for instance, and some competitors have superior vpn service included (bitdefender antivirus plus limits you to 200 mb of vpn data per day, which isn’t much). Still, Bitdefender Antivirus Plus is among the more affordable options, particularly if you’re more interested in the antivirus than the add-ons.

Diungkapkan bahwa savvy users might balk at paying at all, as many free antivirus options exist. Bitdefender itself offers a free antivirus download for both Windows and Android (but not macOS, iOS, or iPadOS). This is a fair choice, though it often means you’ll have to tolerate advertisements urging you to sign up.

Sebagaimana diketahui, buying, downloading, and installing bitdefender antivirus plus is a smooth experience. The payment portal is straightforward. Once the installation is finished, Antivirus Plus automatically runs an initial virus check. The installer is really a downloader, so it’s a small file; the full download required by the installer is roughly 800 megabytes. This took less than five minutes on a Microsoft Surface Laptop 7 running Windows 11.

Sebagaimana diketahui, once installed, the bitdefender antivirus plus interface provides a default dashboard that includes several common actions, including a quick scan, total system scan, and vulnerability scan (the latter looks for problems like a weak account password or an overly permissive network configuration). You’ll also find an option to turn on Bitdefender VPN, which is installed alongside the antivirus—though, as mentioned, you’re limited to 200 MB of data per day unless you upgrade to Bitdefender Premium VPN.

Diungkapkan bahwa these features are largely standard for an antivirus program, though one extra feature requires more explanation: safepay. To be honest, I’m doubtful of the feature’s utility. I don’t believe these are the most common avenues cybercriminals use to obtain payment information; they’re far more likely to buy huge repositories of payment data stolen from compromised companies. This creates a sandboxed browsing environment meant to thwart threats like keyloggers and man-in-the-middle attacks. It’s also rather clunky to launch Safepay for an online purchase, so I don’t think most people will want to use it.

Berdasarkan laporan, i spent most of my time using bitdefender antivirus plus on windows, which i think is the best version of the software. However, macOS is the odd one out with an interface that looks different from its peers and, to my eyes, seems about five years out of date. It’s not terrible and has similar functionality, but I find this a bit odd. The Android and iOS versions look largely similar to it, though of course compressed for a mobile device. It seems like the macOS software is missing a software refresh that other platforms received.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a nice software interface is a perk but, at its core, antivirus software is supposed to stop viruses and other malware. So, how does Bitdefender Antivirus Plus rank?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, bitdefender scored well in av-test’s latest report, where it detected 100 percent of the tested attacks and received an av-test top product certification. It also received high marks from AV-Comparatives, which found it detected 99. 5 percent of threats, enough to earn it the top three-star score. Bitdefender’s consumer products weren’t ranked in the latest SE Labs consumer antivirus report, but the small-business product detected 99 percent of threats and received an AAA ranking in the April 2026 report.

Berdasarkan laporan, the performance hit from bitdefender antivirus plus wasn’t noticeable in typical use of either my windows 11 laptop or my apple macbook air m4. I can imagine this could at times result in a performance hit on a device with 8 GB of RAM. That’s not a lot, and it's in line with what I often see from antivirus programs, though it’s also not trivial. Bitdefender services consumed about 700 MB of memory in total on both platforms. My devices have 32 GB and 24 GB, respectively, however, so I didn’t encounter any issues.

Diungkapkan bahwa bitdefender antivirus plus checks off most boxes for an antivirus program. It’s affordable, easy to use, earns high marks from malware testing labs, and avoids significant performance issues when installed. But I do want to return to a problem I’ve mentioned before: the VPN.

Sebagaimana diketahui, antivirus plus advertises an included vpn. This is true, but it’s actually the free VPN service that anyone can obtain. The service has a strict 200-MB (per day, per device) data cap, which isn’t going to be enough if you want to use it as your main VPN. To be fair, Bitdefender does detail this limitation on its website—but it does seem like an added feature when, in reality, it’s available for free whether you buy Antivirus Plus or not.

Diungkapkan bahwa that could steer you away from bitdefender if you want an antivirus and vpn. Competitors like Norton and McAfee bundle an unlimited VPN service into lower tiers of service, which, though more expensive than Bitdefender Antivirus Plus, are less expensive than Bitdefender Antivirus Plus and Bitdefender Premium VPN combined.

Unfortunate VPN bundling aside, Bitdefender Antivirus Plus is a good choice if you want antivirus for Windows, macOS, Android, and iOS.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it’s particularly competitive if you just want the antivirus protection on its own. But there are plenty of reasons to just go for the antivirus itself (for example, credit and dark web monitoring features might already be available through your bank or another institution). All of the major cybersecurity companies would really prefer it if you bought a bundle (including Bitdefender), and they’re often good value if you actually use all the features. And if antivirus protection is all you want, Bitdefender Antivirus Plus is a superb choice.

Sebagaimana diketahui, bitdefender’s advantage is quite simple. It provides antivirus protection that detects most threats at a price that often undercuts the competition. It’s hard to think of a reason to pay more for an alternative when Bitdefender does the job well for as little as $25 for the first year.

#37. Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions

📅 12 Nov 2026

Google’s latest Search upgrade promises better answers to your most complicated questions

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/googles-latest-search-upgrade-promises-better-answers-to-your-most-complicated-questions/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, google search is getting better at understanding complicated questions, including those with multiple parts, highly specific requests, or confusing typos. The updates are coming via the company’s newly released Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, which Google claims is its “biggest model improvement to Search yet. ”.

While Google’s frontier models, Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini 4 Argon, are best at deep reasoning for hard problems, Hydrogen is designed for fast execution across a variety of agentic workflows, or tasks in which an AI carries out multiple steps on its own, the company explained in an announcement.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the idea behind the model’s release is that using the most powerful model isn’t always needed — sometimes a faster, cheaper, and reasonably smart one will do. Google says Hydrogen completes tasks 2. 5 times faster than Gemini 3. 8 Flash, its previous fast model, but it’s still pretty smart, even beating the more powerful Gemini 4 Argon on one broad intelligence benchmark, the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, at its default high thinking level.

In Search, Hydrogen brings several improvements, including a better understanding of user intent, the ability to offer more helpful links and visual responses, and better answers across the different languages supported by Google’s AI Mode.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in terms of intent, google says hydrogen can handle more nuanced and complicated questions more quickly. This means people can ask their questions in their natural train of thought, including those that have multiple parts or that include highly specific requests. Hydrogen is also better at navigating hard-to-understand typos, Google says. Because of its improvements and better ability to follow instructions and call the right tools, Hydrogen is able to more precisely address each part of a user’s question.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, its advanced reasoning also improves search’s fan-out technique, which breaks down a single user’s prompt into multiple subqueries. This allows people to discover websites related to the query that they may have otherwise missed, the blog post explains.

The addition of Hydrogen to Search will also mean more images, structured responses, comparison tables, and custom tools will appear as visual responses to users’ queries in AI Mode.

Google also says Hydrogen can work on its own for everyday work in areas like writing code, running tests, or verifying code changes, or it can be paired with Carbon and Argon in workflows that combine several models.

The model offers four thinking levels: low, medium, high (default), and a new, extra-high tier (“xhigh”), all of which are designed to complete tasks faster with fewer output tokens.

Berdasarkan laporan, on multi-step tasks like deep research, data analysis, and broad codebase navigation, hydrogen ranks no. 5 on Agent Arena’s benchmarks, the company pointed out.

Google says the Hydrogen update is rolling out to all Search users globally.

Jensen Huang is out as NVIDIA CEO

He has held the position since the company's founding.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on thursday, nvidia's board of directors said that huang had resigned his position as president and chief executive of the company, effective immediately. Huang also gave up his board seat. NVIDIA named Colette Kress, the company's current executive vice president and chief financial officer, as interim CEO.

Diungkapkan bahwa "kress will continue to serve as executive vice president and chief financial officer while serving as interim chief executive officer until a permanent successor has been named," nvidia said. "The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, as part of the shakeup, nvidia also appointed its first-ever chair of the board in harvey jones, who previously served as ceo and executive chairman of electronic design automation company synopsys. "Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position," Jones said in a statement. "She is supported by an experienced leadership team that has been instrumental in executing NVIDIA's strategy and advancing its technology roadmap. The Board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team, and we expect the company's operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang's departure comes days after nvidia's board said it would investigate huang after he admitted to having an affair with a former tech executive accused of being a chinese intelligence asset. The board said at the time it had "no reason to believe that either national security or NVIDIA secrets were compromised. " The FBI is also investigating, according to President Donald Trump.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the new york times later reported that huang had also had an affair with an nvidia executive who reported to him, and that the two were seen "being affectionate" at a hotel during a company conference this year. A bystander who reportedly recorded the interaction was offered a nondisclosure agreement by Huang's security detail, according to the report.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang's downfall is a stunning turn for the company, which has become a linchpin for the ai industry. He has been CEO since co-founding the company in 1993. Since then, he has transformed NVIDIA from a 3D graphics company to an AI powerhouse worth more than $4 trillion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as nvidia's stock price has exploded in recent years huang has become an increasingly public face of the ai boom. He often appeared at events — usually wearing his signature black leather jacket — with fellow tech CEOs like Mark Zuckerberg and Satya Nadella. At a time when high profile AI researchers are raising the alarm about superintelligence, Huang has had a much more positive view on the technology. He argued against increased regulation of the industry and has said America should not restrict China's access to US-made chips.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang has frequently been seen with president trump, and was one of several tech leaders to accompany him on a recent trip to china. Asked about recent revelations, the president said he believed Huang was "an honorable guy" and that he "probably has an excuse for it. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa in a memo to nvidia employees earlier this week in which he apologized for his actions, huang wrote that leading the company was "the privilege of my life" and that he was "committed to protecting nvidia and supporting america's national security. " He added that he was "fully committed to NVIDIA" and would "work to earn back your confidence. " But the CEO who once seemed untouchable won't get the chance to do so.

JetBlue Airways unveiled its new domestic first-class seats Wednesday as more of the country's carriers bet on the premium travel boom to make them profitable again.

Berdasarkan laporan, jetblue announced it would offer a domestic first class — bluefirst — in december 2024 and plans to start flying aircraft with the new seats and full on-board product next month. Kennedy International Airport on Wednesday. The carrier showed off the new cabin at its home hub at John F. Retrofits will continue during 2027, CEO Joanna Geraghty told CNBC late last month.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jetblue will have 12 of the seats on its airbus a320 fleet and 30 extra-legroom seats, down from 42 of those options previously. Diungkapkan bahwa the rollout comes as the new york airline tries to stabilize after last posting a profit in 2019. Last month, JetBlue executives sought to calm investors after shares in the airline hit a record low following a report that bondholders had contracted restructuring advisors.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "we have no intention, no plans to file for bankruptcy. We are not engaged with any restructuring company," Geraghty told CNBC in an interview on Oct. 27.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, geraghty told cnbc's phil lebeau on wednesday that jetblue has "met with a few of the creditors over the last couple of weeks as part of. normal investor engagement. " She said the company made it clear to bondholders that JetBlue doesn't need to reorganize.

JetBlue is betting that resilient travel demand, especially for roomier seats will help fuel its turnaround plan, which aims to get the carrier to an operating profit next year and $1 in adjusted earnings per share in 2028.

Sebagaimana diketahui, airline executives have said they expect fares to stay elevated next year as they grapple with higher costs, including but not limited to fuel, such as labor and airport fees. Geraghty said Wednesday that even if fuel prices moderate next year, "I don't think fares are going to fall as much as people expect. ".

For example, a ticket in the new recliner first-class seats between Kennedy airport and Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport in Florida is going for $847 roundtrip in the first week of March while standard economy is $446.

Berdasarkan laporan, on tuesday, budget carrier frontier airlines unveiled its new first-class seats, which will take up the first two rows, and said it would outfit its airbus fleet with premium seating that has extra legroom and in-seat power through row eight. The airline will take out a row of seating on its planes to make the pricier ones fit, Chief Marketing Officer Bobby Schroeter told CNBC in an interview Monday.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, jetblue last month reported that it ended the third quarter with $2. 2 billion in liquidity and that its unencumbered asset base is now $7 billion, including $2. 8 billion in aircraft and engines.

Diungkapkan bahwa jetblue had total debt of $8. 4 billion as of Sept. 30, the carrier said in its earnings filing.

Sebagaimana diketahui, geraghty told cnbc last month there is a "fundamental disconnect between the narrative in the bond market and what our financial results actually demonstrate. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, when asked whether jetblue's eye on keeping costs down includes furloughs, layoffs or buyouts, geraghty last month said "absolutely not. ".

S. U. The launch also comes as more brands turn to creators to reach customers.
