#106. Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry

📅 12 Nov 2026

Five ways Jensen Huang’s ouster from Nvidia could damage the AI industry

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/five-ways-jensen-huangs-ouster-from-nvidia-could-damage-the-ai-industry/

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s confession that he had an affair (and reports of another one with a direct report) that led the board to oust him on Thursday isn’t just your run-of-the-mill salacious billionaire CEO sex scandal.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in this case, one of his lovers is suspected by the u. S. government of being a spy for China. She’s also an executive of a Singapore-based neocloud that is suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China.

Berdasarkan laporan, these affairs show undeniably poor judgment by huang and, i’d argue, unchecked hubris on many levels. Sleeping with any Nvidia partner is bad enough, but he also chose one in a tinderbox of a geopolitical situation. Such choices are not only a betrayal of his wife of 40 years, they’re also a liability for his company. Even if Alice Huang’s company wasn’t suspected of helping Chinese firms evade chip restrictions (and he was somehow unaware of this), it was still exploiting a legal loophole by renting powerful AI infrastructure to Chinese companies.

Diungkapkan bahwa it’s those potential national consequences that may land him in a hellscape of ongoing public humiliation. Republican committee chairs are already summoning him to testify in closed-door sessions about the security ramifications.

Diungkapkan bahwa will democrats, who are set to take over key committees when the new congress convenes in january, also haul him in to testify on the hill? no one knows yet, but huang has flaunted his close relationship with president trump. Remember when Trump called him while he was onstage at the All-In Summit in September? Nvidia also donated $25 million to Trump’s ballroom, a deeply unpopular project with American voters. Several Democratic lawmakers have already vowed to investigate the money behind it.

Diungkapkan bahwa in other words, he is a billionaire close to trump. He was — until Thursday — the face of AI and data centers (also a deeply unpopular political topic with voters), and he has publicly admitted to having an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Even though he’s no longer CEO, that seems too juicy a target for Democrats to ignore.

Sebagaimana diketahui, beyond whatever may be coming, huang’s influence has been lost right when he was using it to push the tech industry in a number of directions. These areas have now lost their biggest champion.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang has been the biggest, loudest advocate for open-weight ai models in the tech industry and among government policymakers. 9 billion. It has even agreed to acquire the biggest site that hosts them, Hugging Face, for $12. Nvidia not only offers its own open-weight models, it also offers a lot of other open source tech for agents, AI security, and more. (That deal is supposed to close in the first half of next year, pending regulatory approval. ).

In July, when Anthropic and OpenAI were reportedly urging the Trump administration to ban Chinese open-weight models, Huang organized a letter of support for open-weight models generally (if not Chinese models specifically), signed by hundreds of tech companies.

Berdasarkan laporan, open-weight models give enterprises choice in the market and reduce costs. Without Huang, the next biggest advocate for them is perhaps Microsoft’s Satya Nadella, but he’s not out there organizing the industry to speak up.

Diungkapkan bahwa both openai and anthropic revealed incident after incident this year as their ai agents hacked into others’ networks or performed other misdeeds. Huang loudly proclaimed the AI industry still didn’t need regulation and would deal with safety itself.

Berdasarkan laporan, as the industry mulled over what they should do (auditors? a finra-like board?), huang rallied the tech industry again. Nvidia got over 100 companies to sign on to his Open Agent Safety Platform, a largely open source effort to solve the epidemic of misbehaving AI agents.

Naturally, this effort hasn’t instantly solved the problem, and now the top spokesperson for self-regulation via technology solutions is out of his position of influence.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, huang has also been among the loudest voices insisting that ai is an engineered system that creates products, and so can be controlled like any other engineered system. This viewpoint counters the AI doomers and even the big AI labs themselves, which sometimes position their models as on the verge of consciousness (Anthropic) or as alien minds (OpenAI).

While Huang deals with the fallout of his actions, the loudest voice of this counter-narrative is, for the foreseeable future, silenced.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang also just convinced a long list of pc makers to buy into his long-time dream of providing cpus (the main processor chips) for them. In this age, when most Americans have not experienced AI beyond a chatbot, he orchestrated a new line of high-end AI PCs geared for running agents locally.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these new pcs are due out this holiday season, and they may sell well for their intended targets: creators, developers, and others already savvy with agents. But now that Huang has become a meme for cheating on his wife with an alleged spy, he’s perhaps not the best choice to help market these devices as a cool alternative to the Mac mini.

Berdasarkan laporan, huang demolished his reputation right as bond underwriters (lenders) and bond buyers are pretty much over ai build-out-related debt. Of roughly $80 billion in data center bonds issued this year, nearly half were rated high-risk “junk,” Forbes reports.

Berdasarkan laporan, undeterred, huang has been coming up with ways to continue financing the boom and keep his company’s revenues growing. Certainly, he’s authorized a mind-boggling number of so-called circular deals, where Nvidia buys stakes in companies to fund their expansion so they can buy chips. By some accounts, the company had committed to $750 billion in such deals as of July, Bloomberg reported. In August, Nvidia got even bolder, agreeing to backstop $105 billion in financing for an OpenAI data center in Ohio, CNBC reported.

Sebagaimana diketahui, huang also convinced a whole new set of financiers to pony up. In August, he announced that deep-pocketed PE firms Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs, and KKR had committed up to $500 billion for data center build outs. He promised them that the data centers’ Nvidia GPUs could be used as collateral because Nvidia was guaranteeing the chips would retain value.

Diungkapkan bahwa huang sold a vision of nvidia as “investable infrastructure” with a long resale cycle, like airplanes. Then he made the rounds with the financial press, as he often did, to pitch his vision. Now, however, Wall Street is concerned that Nvidia’s stock will crash and take their portfolios, and possibly the economy, with it.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nvidia has lost its top salesperson and the ai industry has lost its top hype man. Even if Huang somehow comes back into the public eye to champion AI again, every interview and meeting will be about his sex life, choices, and national security — not his vision for the industry.

We’ll have to wait and see how Nvidia navigates the scandal Huang heaped onto it, but now that the company is finally in its post “founder mode” era, and hunting for a new CEO, it’s doubtful it has the cache to push the industry the way Huang was.

#109. 12 12 12 is the final boss of nonlinear TV

📅 13 Nov 2026

12 12 12 is the final boss of nonlinear TV

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://mashable.com/entertainment/12-12-12-apple-tv

From multiple timelines to extended flashback episodes, you can barely get through a TV show nowadays without taking a hop, skip, and a jump through time.

Berdasarkan laporan, of course, tv has a rich tradition of playing with chronology. Lost's nonlinear approach revolutionized episodic storytelling, inspiring mystery-box series with several timelines like Westworld and Yellowjackets. While these techniques can build out fun puzzles or deepen our knowledge of characters, they can also devolve into nothing more than flashy gimmicks. Its use of character-focused flashbacks also lingers today, present everywhere from Paradise to Euphoria. Case in point: Apple TV's new heist drama 12 12 12.

Want more film and TV news and reviews delivered straight to your inbox? Sign up for Mashable’s Top Stories newsletter or get Mashable push alerts today.

12 12 12 unfolds across three different timelines: the 12 months of planning leading up to a billion-dollar heist on a Swiss bank; the 12 hours of the heist itself; and the 12 days after, in which FBI agent Jack Strickland (Anthony Mackie) hunts thief Paul Galvin (Jamie Dornan) and his accomplices.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you forget the structure of the show, don't worry. It also uses a series of split screens to remind you when we're entering a new timeline, be it "The Planning," "The Heist," or "The Takedown. 12 12 12 lays it out for you at the top of every episode with the help of voiceover from Mackie. " The amount of hand-holding to get you onboard with the show's premise alone feels tailor-made for audiences who are second-screening the show, a stark contrast from other multi-timeline shows that trust audiences to pick up on context clues.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on paper, 12 12 12's timeline idea is fascinating. Yet even though the show is built around nonlinear storytelling, the cracks in its conceit quickly begin to show.

Diungkapkan bahwa a large driving force of any heist story is the tension of whether an unlikely team can pull off an even more unlikely robbery. During the "Planning" timeline, we know thanks to the "Heist" timeline that the heist will eventually take place. Any supposed roadblocks feel hollow. 12 12 12 undercuts much of that tension from the get-go. During the "Heist" timeline, we know thanks to the "Takedown" timeline that the money makes it out of the bank vault. Only the "Takedown" causes any adrenaline spikes, as Jack and Paul's cat-and-mouse game begins in earnest, with no definitive outcome spelled out for us.

Berdasarkan laporan, another driving force of heist stories is the how of the heist, all the delicious twists and turns and plans within plans that play out during the job. These twists could have solved 12 12 12's tension problem. However, the show becomes far too liberal with them down the line, seemingly in hopes of keeping the wool over our eyes, as if to prove we don't actually know the arc of the story.

Berdasarkan laporan, as 12 12 12 veers into increasingly bizarre territory — an incident with an avalanche earned a major groan from me — it sacrifices credibility and character. The latter is an overworked agent with an obsessive drive to catch these criminals. The former is a charismatic criminal roped into one last job before settling down as a family man. Despite solid performances from Dornan and Mackie, neither Paul nor Jack truly break free from classic heist archetypes. The pair at least fare better than the other underutilized members of Paul's team, most of whom are total afterthoughts. Even when they're introduced in the "Planning" timeline, there is no "aha" moment of recognition, because there's so little of them to latch onto in the "Heist" and "Takedown" timelines.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, would 12 12 12 work better if it wasn't so tied to tv's nonlinear trend? perhaps. The heist and its aftermath do come with the occasional slick thrill. Unfortunately, they're so tied up in clichés that said thrills wear off fast. The freshest thing about 12 12 12 remains its structure, but in an age dominated by nonlinear storytelling, this seemingly out-of-the-box structure becomes the last thing it wants to be: conventional.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the first two episodes of 12 12 12 are now streaming on apple tv, with a new episode every friday. #114. Netflix releases new trailer for Ray Gunn

Berdasarkan laporan, we caught the first trailer for the upcoming netflix animated film ray gunn in september and were charmed by director brad bird’s blend of a jetsons-like future with classic 1930s noir detective thrillers. Bird has described it as a mashup of The Maltese Falcon and Buck Rogers, and the latest trailer definitely gives off that energy.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as previously reported, bird has directed some of our all-time favorite animated films: the iron giant (1999), the incredibles (2004), and ratatouille (2007), with the latter two snagging well-deserved oscar wins. He’s been kicking around the idea for Ray Gunn for the last 30 years, working on his many other film projects while the Ray Gunn script—co-written by Matthew Robbins, who also co-wrote 1987’s Batteries Not Included with Bird—“stayed in a filing cabinet at Warner Brothers,” the director said earlier this year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the film’s inspiration came when bird heard the opening of the b-52s’ “planet claire” (a personal favorite that also provides the soundtrack to the new trailer) and initially thought it was a cover of henry mancini’s theme music from the classic tv show peter gunn. Bird is a longtime fan of film noir and hard-boiled detectives, and he came up with the idea of a futuristic detective named Ray Gunn (a play on “raygun,” of course). “It’s film noir and a hard-boiled detective story, but it’s got a lot more comedy and a lot more action than the average film noir,” said Bird.

Berdasarkan laporan, per the official premise: “in metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye raymond gunn (voiced by sam rockwell) is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder, and a multimedia star named venus nova (voiced by scarlett johansson). ”.

Unlike Bird’s Pixar fare, Ray Gunn targets a slightly older demographic with more mature themes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in addition to rockwell and johansson, the all-star voice cast includes tom waits as ray’s one-eyed alien colleague, eyera (pronounced ira); matt berry as alien mob boss francis “sluggy” xavier; bobby cannavale as venus’ husband, who hires ray to spy on his wife; alan tudyk as venus’ manager, barry vogel; michael chernus as a studio fixer named sam; and patton oswalt as a hologram. Bird provides the voices for Xavier’s alien henchmen, Gunsol and Musker. Kathryn Hunter, John Ratzenberger, and Jamie Costa will also voice as-yet-undisclosed characters.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ray gunn releases on netflix on december 18, 2026—the same day both avengers: doomsday and dune: part 3 hit theaters, so it will be alternative family fare for those disinclined to brave the holiday theatrical crowds. The film will also screen in select theaters on December 4, 2026.

#122. A new treasure map reveals where Earth's lost prehistoric life may be hiding

📅 12 Nov 2026

A new treasure map reveals where Earth's lost prehistoric life may be hiding

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261112025529.htm

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, fossils provide an extraordinary window into earth's distant past, revealing the animals, plants, and ecosystems that existed millions of years ago. Fossilization is exceptionally rare, meaning that just a tiny fraction of the organisms that once lived on Earth have been preserved. Yet the fossil record tells only part of the story. Even when fossils survive, scientists can only discover them if the rock layers containing them are accessible today.

Berdasarkan laporan, as a result, our picture of prehistoric life is filled with major gaps. Some geological periods and parts of the world have produced abundant fossils, giving scientists a detailed understanding of the life that existed there. Other periods and regions remain largely unexplored. Because fossil excavations require considerable time and resources, knowing where to search could make a major difference in uncovering new evidence of ancient life.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to help solve this problem, thomas a. Neubauer of the Bavarian State Collections of Natural History (SNSB) and Mathias Harzhauser of the Natural History Museum in Vienna have developed a new tool for guiding fossil research. The two paleontologists analyzed the geographic distribution of fossil discoveries from animals that inhabited shallow marine environments over the past 540 million years. For the first time, they also mapped the regions of the world where fossil information is missing, providing a clearer picture of where future discoveries may be possible.

Mapping 540 Million Years of Ancient Marine Life.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to build their map, the researchers examined records from the paleobiology database (pbdb), the world's leading freely accessible repository of fossil information. The database contains a substantial portion of the paleontological findings published by scientists around the world.

Sebagaimana diketahui, using these records, the team reconstructed where fossils from ancient shallow marine environments have been documented throughout earth's history. They also examined how fossil research has developed over decades and centuries, measuring how frequently investigations in different regions have produced new scientific information.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the researchers then compared these findings with geological information from the macrostat database. This allowed them to assess not only where fossils have already been discovered, but also where suitable rock formations could provide opportunities to fill important gaps in the fossil record.

Where Earth's Missing Fossils May Be Hiding.

Berdasarkan laporan, the analysis revealed a surprising imbalance in our understanding of prehistoric life. 539 to 252 million years ago) have already been studied extensively. The Early Mesozoic (approx. 252 to 66 million years ago) and the Palaeozoic (approx. According to the researchers, additional fossil discoveries from these periods are unlikely to produce a substantial increase in scientific knowledge in the near future.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the greatest opportunities for expanding the fossil record may instead lie in more recent geological history. Although scientists have already collected extensive evidence from the Cenozoic Era (beginning 66 million years ago), the analysis suggests that its shallow marine deposits still contain significant untapped potential for fossil discoveries.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to help researchers investigate this period, the team identified locations around the world where previously unknown fossil species are especially likely to be found. Crucially, these are also places where the appropriate geological layers are exposed or otherwise accessible, making actual discoveries possible.

A Treasure Map for Future Fossil Discoveries.

Berdasarkan laporan, by highlighting regions where important evidence may still be waiting, the new approach could help paleontologists plan more productive expeditions and make better use of limited research resources. Rather than concentrating on areas that have already been explored extensively, scientists can focus on locations with the greatest potential to reveal something new about Earth's prehistoric ecosystems.

"The fact that many regions of the Earth remain unexplored offers hope for valuable new discoveries," says SNSB paleobiologist Neubauer.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "but precisely because expanding the fossil record is quite challenging and progresses only slowly, our work can help researchers worldwide to focus their research specifically on these still largely unexplored areas. The same applies to the examination of existing museum collections awaiting scientific analysis. Through sensible prioritization, we can fill gaps in the fossil record strategically. We provide a valuable guide for planning future projects and excavation campaigns. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the network, called whoop humans, will be rolled out in the whoop app to members at every membership tier at no extra cost. Followers can react and comment; members can also attach photos and commentary to their data. Members can follow anyone on Whoop and choose what to share, from sleep and recovery to workouts and achievements. It’s all opt-in, CEO Will Ahmed tells us.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, whoop already has a social feature, teams, which a little more than half its customers use, according to the company. Humans is meant to be more intimate. But Teams is built around groups and leaderboards, and everyone in a group sees everyone else’s information. Members decide who follows them and who sees what, so a trainer can track a set of clients without the clients seeing one another’s data, for example.

Sebagaimana diketahui, i found myself questioning how much a spouse wants to know about the other’s sleep score when ahmed mentioned this particular scenario, so i asked him how else beta members used these newer social features. He said the company learned that people were more engaged when someone reported a low recovery score than a nearly perfect one, suggesting that the new feature may be particularly helpful for understanding when someone is struggling and might need attention.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, indeed, the bigger story here is where whoop continues to be headed, which is into medical wellness. Like its most direct rival, Oura, the company is pushing faster and more aggressively into the wellness opportunity that an aging population presents.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, whoop had already added fda-cleared ecg and atrial fibrillation detection, blood pressure insights, blood testing, and medical-record uploads. Asked if older customers are gravitating to Whoop, Ahmed said, without offering specifics, that Whoop has seen “huge growth” among people over 60 over the past 18 months. He also said his was among the first companies accepted into a Medicare program that reimburses qualifying wearables that can show they improve health outcomes, and that it now has Medicare members.

Berdasarkan laporan, he added that he expects families to be big users of humans. (You can imagine adult children checking in on aging parents. ).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but the company’s efforts to be thought of as the “brand for personal health” raises questions, naturally, about privacy. Activities marked sensitive aren’t shared by default, and Ahmed said health alerts and medical information aren’t shared at all. Ahmed said members choose which metrics to share, can remove followers, and can switch on “stealth mode” to go dark for a few days without changing their settings. Members can also report any comment or photo that they deem disturbing, and the company said reported content is reviewed.

Diungkapkan bahwa as for minors, whoop’s minimum age is 13 for all members (higher in some countries), meaning customers of that age can share their data subject to consents and privacy settings. Asked whether a parent could follow a teenager’s data, he didn’t answer directly and pointed to the privacy controls.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ahmed also said whoop doesn’t sell member data. “Our product is not you; it’s the membership,” he said, adding that the company doesn’t license data to third parties.

Diungkapkan bahwa he was candid about dealmaking. Asked about Oura’s announcement this week that it will pay $625 million for Counsel Health, a service offering on-demand physicians, Ahmed said he expects “more consolidation” among AI-focused, clinician-focused, and wearable companies, and that Whoop is always on the prowl. Its deep relationship with members, he said, puts it “in a position to be an acquirer. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa he was more guarded about the company’s own finances, declining to share revenue or say whether whoop is profitable. He did say that the company now has about 1,200 employees, membership on its software platform has increased more than 70% a year for three years running, and that it expects to have nearly 4 million members by year-end.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for an ipo (the company raised a very big round earlier this year), he said only that whoop “will certainly ipo in the future. ” He also wouldn’t comment on Oura, which shelved its own IPO of up to $2. 2 billion in September citing market uncertainty.

Berdasarkan laporan, in the meantime, whoop is widening its reach. The company announced that its devices will be sold through Ulta stores beginning next March (around 500 locations of the beauty retailer to start, and a target to retail in more than a thousand stores eventually). Indeed, Ahmed said Whoop’s female audience has more than doubled from last year.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as for competition, in addition to google’s new fitbit air band, whoop may soon have to contend with apple, which is reportedly developing a whoop-style band. But Ahmed mostly shrugged off those concerns, suggesting that building a product doesn’t guarantee success. Instead, he said, Whoop’s job is to stay true to the “aspiring” people it serves.

#126. Building a rocket is hard. AST SpaceMobile thinks it's "simple."

📅 12 Nov 2026

Building a rocket is hard. AST SpaceMobile thinks it's "simple."

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/space/2026/11/building-a-rocket-is-hard-ast-spacemobile-thinks-its-simple/

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we’re not doing this thing because we like rockets. ”.

During an hour-long event on Thursday, Abel Avellan, the founder and chief executive of the telecommunications company AST SpaceMobile, laid out his vision for developing a large rocket to launch his Bluebird satellites into orbit.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, avellan emphasized, over and over again, that ast plans to build a “simple” rocket. He paraphrased SpaceX founder Elon Musk several times, saying, “the best part is no part. ” Avellan emphasized that AST has already procured engines for its proposed Blacklift rocket, asserting that engine development accounts for 80 percent of a typical rocket’s development cycle.

Diungkapkan bahwa “of course rocket engineers are going to get mad with me, but you can simplify it as a big tank feeding engines,” he said of the rocket. We know how to do them. We know how to do them in composite. “So big tanks—we know how to do them. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, i am not a rocket engineer, and i am not mad at avellan. But he sure seems to be substantially underestimating the challenge of building rockets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, avellan also has a problem. AST SpaceMobile appears to be successful in building very large satellites, Bluebirds, that are capable of providing direct-to-cell capability from an orbit about 550km above Earth. The problem is there is a commercial launch crunch, and the company is struggling to get its satellites on orbit today, and projects to do so into the future.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we’re not doing this thing because we like rockets,” he said during the presentation. “We’re not doing this thing because we want to be in the launch business. We want this because we have so much demand of our satellites, and as you have seen it, we cannot get enough launches. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the blacklift rocket will be “simple,” he said, because it will be solely tailored to lift five bluebird satellites into low-earth orbit at a time. It will have all composite tanks and three stages. It will have 20 metric tons of lift capacity, a reusable first stage, and launch twice a month from a pad at Wallops Flight Facility in Virginia that formerly served the Antares rocket. And, Avellan said, it will be ready to launch in 2028.

If that timeline sounds preposterous, that’s because it is.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, avellan believes ast has a workaround: it is committed to spending $1. He is basing this argument on the Miranda first stage engine, which he said is “ready to fly. 3 billion to acquire enough engines for the first three Blacklift launches from Firefly Aerospace, as well as a license to manufacture additional engines over time. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa but that’s not quite true. However, Miranda has not yet completed its formal qualification campaign, much less flown on an orbital rocket. Firefly chief executive Jason Kim said this week that qualification testing remains underway. Moreover, little is known publicly about the readiness of the upper stage engine, Vira, that AST is also acquiring from Firefly for its rocket.

Sebagaimana diketahui, another questionable assertion is avellan’s statement that 80 percent of a rocket’s design cycle is due to engine development. “I mean, that has been proven,” he said.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, i’m not sure it has. Propulsion is definitely one of the most challenging aspects of developing a rocket.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, however, rocket lab, which has considerably more experience building orbital rockets than ast, has suffered two significant setbacks this year involving neutron’s composite propellant tanks. These structures, as well as flight software, avionics, stage separation, payload fairings, qualification testing, and so much more, can lead to significant delays in the development of a rocket. And then there are the equally difficult challenges of scaling from development to production at rate, and recovering the first stage.

Diungkapkan bahwa avellan and scott wisniewski, president of ast spacemobile, also did not get into specifics about financing the development of blacklift. The company has already invested more than $1 billion in engines and will likely need billions more to develop and scale the vehicle.

Diungkapkan bahwa wisniewski said ast spacemobile plans to spend “several hundred million dollars” in 2027 on blacklift development, but it is not clear whether that includes milestone payments to firefly for propulsion. According to the company’s balance sheet, it had about $2. 8 billion in unrestricted cash and cash equivalents at the end of September, and it has historically been successful in raising additional capital.

Berdasarkan laporan, the company’s underlying business plan makes sense. Traditional mobile service operators are growing wary about working with SpaceX, viewing the company as a competitor rather than a partner. There is a potentially very large market for space-to-ground connectivity for mobile devices. And the recent issues with Starlink in Ukraine may lead some nations to seek alternative partners for these services.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “first of all, i’m no musk, and i don’t want to be,” avellan said on thursday. We don’t insult them. “We partner. We don’t compete with them. … Why? Because we partner with them. We enhance. You know, we partner with them. We don’t compete. ”.

Sebagaimana diketahui, spacex went from being a rocket company to operating satellites. Consider that SpaceX took eight years from its founding to launch the Falcon 9, another five years to successfully land a booster, and several more years to achieve a high flight rate. Now Avellan and AST seek to go from being a satellite operator to launching rockets. AST is seeking to compress much of that process into approximately two years.

Diungkapkan bahwa but rocket science is in no way simple, and the road ahead is sure to be rocky. Avellan said AST doesn’t really want to be in the launch business. Given how difficult, demanding, and expensive the launch business is, he may get his wish in a few years.

The Nvidia Board of Directors announced on Thursday morning that the company’s co-founder and CEO of 33 years, Jensen Huang, has resigned as president, CEO, and member of the board, effective immediately.

Berdasarkan laporan, this is a shocking twist for one of the most valuable companies in the world, which designs the chips that make the ai boom possible. Few people would have predicted this turn of events even just a week ago, as Huang has been so central to Nvidia throughout the company’s existence that he never even established a succession plan. But Huang has now been ousted after reports that he had affairs with both an alleged Chinese spy and one of his direct reports at Nvidia.

Diungkapkan bahwa while the company conducts a more thorough search for huang’s successor, nvidia cfo and executive vice president colette kress has taken over as interim ceo. But beyond her name and job title, what do we know about the person who will now lead a company worth about $3. 8 trillion?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, according to nvidia’s website, kress has worked at the company since september 2013. Before that, she spent three years as an SVP and CFO of Cisco’s Business Technology Operations Finance organization. She holds a finance degree from the University of Arizona and an MBA from Southern Methodist University.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the california-based 59-year-old has a very limited social media presence — on linkedin, she has commented some well wishes on former colleagues’ posts about their retirement. Berdasarkan laporan, according to forbes’ list of america’s richest self-made women, kress’ net worth is estimated to be about $1. 2 billion. Her Forbes profile adds that she initially joined Nvidia in part because her two sons endorsed the company for its role in the video game industry, which it was best known for at the time.

Berdasarkan laporan, “nvidias strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, i am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation jensen created over the last 33 years,” kress said in a statement. “We will continue advancing the work that has made Nvidia a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders. ”.

Nvidia is slated to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, when we will likely hear more from Kress about her plans for the company’s immediate future.

#134. NASA’s Perseverance confirms a key ingredient for life hidden in ancient Mars rocks

📅 12 Nov 2026

NASA’s Perseverance confirms a key ingredient for life hidden in ancient Mars rocks

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261111005908.htm

Sebagaimana diketahui, organic carbon has been confirmed in two ancient martian rocks examined by nasa's perseverance rover, adding an important new piece to the puzzle of whether mars once supported life. Even more surprising, the material was found just beneath the planet's surface, where harsh conditions can destroy organic compounds.

Diungkapkan bahwa the discovery builds on nasa's september 2025 announcement that perseverance had identified a potential biosignature. A potential biosignature is a substance or feature that could have formed through biological activity, although other explanations are possible. Now, research published in Science Advances provides definitive confirmation that the same two rocks, located in Mars' Bright Angel formation, contain organic carbon, an essential component of life. The findings also offer a clearer picture of the material's characteristics and how it may have been preserved.

The study was co-led by Ashley Murphy, a postdoctoral researcher at the Planetary Science Institute, and Kyle Uckert, Deputy Principal Investigator of the SHERLOC instrument.

NASA's Perseverance Rover Detects Complex Organic Carbon.

Diungkapkan bahwa to investigate the rocks, researchers used the scanning habitable environments with raman & luminescence for organics & chemicals (sherloc) instrument mounted on perseverance's robotic arm. The instrument examined several rocks in the Bright Angel formation within Jezero crater, where the rover also collected a sample from a rock named "Cheyava Falls. ".

SHERLOC uses a technique called Raman spectroscopy, which shines laser light onto a material to identify and map its minerals and organic compounds without damaging the rock.

Diungkapkan bahwa the measurements revealed macromolecular carbon (mmc), a form of carbon consisting of large, interconnected networks of carbon atoms. This type of material is also found in rocks on Earth and in meteorites. Importantly, it can form through biological activity or through chemical processes that do not involve life, so its presence alone cannot establish that Mars was once inhabited.

Diungkapkan bahwa the surrounding geology offers additional clues about how the material reached these rocks. Billions of years ago, water flowed through a river channel into Jezero crater, carrying sediment that gradually settled on the bottom. Over time, those fine particles hardened into the mudstone formations Perseverance is now exploring.

Diungkapkan bahwa researchers detected the carbon within these ancient sediments and alongside carbonate and sulfate minerals that developed later as water altered the rocks. This distribution raises the possibility that organic material entered or formed within the rocks during at least two separate periods of Mars' geological history.

"While the specific formation mechanism of the MMC detected in the Bright Angel mudstones remains unknown, this is still one of the most exciting findings to date," Murphy said.

Organic Carbon Survives Just Beneath Mars' Harsh Surface.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the most striking results concerns where the organic carbon was found. The material survived only a few microns below the exposed Martian surface, at a depth smaller than the thickness of a sheet of paper. This is the shallowest detection of macromolecular carbon ever reported on Mars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, that location makes the finding particularly unusual. Mars' surface is exposed to radiation, sunlight, and chemically reactive substances that can break down organic molecules. Scientists would generally expect these conditions to make long-term preservation especially difficult so close to the surface.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the martian surface environment includes radiation and chemical oxidants that are destructive to organics, and terrestrial laboratory simulations have shown that the survival time of organics in martian-like conditions -- especially at or near the surface -- depends on factors such as the type of organic molecule and the surrounding minerals," murphy said. "The MMC detected in the Bright Angel mudstones is either resistant to degradation and/or has been sufficiently shielded by other minerals, such as clays, or iron-rich Martian soil. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in other words, the carbon may have survived because of its own chemical durability, protection provided by surrounding minerals, or a combination of the two. Understanding how it endured could help scientists determine where similar organic compounds might remain preserved elsewhere on Mars.

Ancient Martian Lakes and Rivers May Have Been Rich in Organic Material.

The findings also suggest that organic carbon may not have been confined to a single region of ancient Mars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, perseverance collected the bright angel sample more than 2,000 miles from gale crater, where nasa's curiosity rover previously detected organic compounds. Finding organic material at such widely separated locations suggests that the chemistry associated with life's building blocks may once have been common across the Martian landscape.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "it is encouraging for martian habitability," murphy said. "This indicates that billions of years ago, organics may have been more than just locally present and may have been more widely available in ancient lakes and rivers on Mars. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the possibility of widespread organic material is significant because ancient mars once had environments containing liquid water. If organic compounds were also broadly available, some of those lakes and rivers may have offered important chemical ingredients for life.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, discovering those ingredients does not mean that living organisms were present. Organic carbon can be produced without biology, and scientists still need to determine exactly how the material in the Bright Angel rocks formed.

Could Martian Rocks Preserve Evidence of Ancient Life?.

Sebagaimana diketahui, determining whether the bright angel formation contains fossilized microorganisms remains beyond the capabilities of the rovers currently exploring mars. Neither Curiosity in Gale Crater nor Perseverance in Jezero Crater carries the large, energy-intensive laboratory equipment needed to conclusively distinguish fossil evidence of ancient life from geological processes.

Diungkapkan bahwa perseverance was designed to search for potential biosignatures, including features like those identified in the cheyava falls rock. From that perspective, the discovery represents a "resounding win for Mars science," Murphy said.

Diungkapkan bahwa the next major step would be to examine martian samples using the more sophisticated instruments available in laboratories on earth. Such equipment could reveal details too small or chemically subtle for the rover's instruments to resolve, helping researchers determine whether biological processes or nonliving chemistry produced the organic carbon.

Berdasarkan laporan, if samples from the bright angel formation eventually reach earth, scientists hope to study their minerals and organic compounds with much greater sensitivity and resolution. These investigations could help explain how the macromolecular carbon formed, how it survived, and what its presence reveals about the distribution of organic material across Mars.

Sebagaimana diketahui, murphy continues to collaborate with the sherloc science team as perseverance explores the martian surface. Her research also includes studying Earth materials that resemble Martian rocks and using Raman spectroscopy to improve how scientists interpret the measurements returned by the rover.

Diungkapkan bahwa murphy's work on sherloc instrument mars 2020 was supported through jpl subcontract no. 1641753 to the Planetary Science Institute.

Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon told CNBC on Monday that financing demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure remains strong despite recent market jitters as investors reassess the risks involving the massive build-out.

Solomon said that his firm has been "very active" in AI capital markets deals over recent weeks, a setup that he expects to continue.

"There's still very strong demand for investments in the AI infrastructure build and the technology around the growth of AI," Solomon told CNBC's Leslie Picker.

Diungkapkan bahwa changes in the political environment are among factors that will "create recalibrations and ups and downs, and we're seeing some of that," solomon said. "But I still deeply believe in the long-term trajectory of the power of AI in our economy to drive productivity. ".

AI-related stocks, including chipmakers and neocloud providers, have tumbled in recent weeks as investors reassess whether the hundreds of billions of dollars being poured into AI infrastructure will generate good returns.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the selloff, which began before the u. S. midterm elections, intensified after Democrats scored sweeping victories on Tuesday, raising concerns that political opposition could slow the industry's expansion.

Diungkapkan bahwa the shifting sentiment comes at a key moment for ai model lab anthropic, which is preparing for a potential ipo that could become one of the biggest tests yet of public-market appetite for ai companies. Goldman is among the banks leading that IPO process.

Berdasarkan laporan, "we'll see, obviously, if this ipo moves forward, how it all plays out," solomon said, declining to comment in detail about the ipo. "I would say that the market environment is still pretty constructive. ".

Diungkapkan bahwa solomon also pushed back against political resistance to data center construction, arguing that the infrastructure is essential to the u. S. economy and that it can be built responsibly.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we certainly don't want this infrastructure going to places outside the u. S. , which is what will naturally happen because the demand for compute is there," Solomon said.

#141. Crows can make decisions twice as fast as humans, scientists discover

📅 12 Nov 2026

Crows can make decisions twice as fast as humans, scientists discover

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261111005850.htm

Berdasarkan laporan, crows can make visual decisions twice as quickly as humans and monkeys, according to new research from the university of tübingen. In experiments involving two carrion crows, the birds needed an average of just 235 milliseconds to determine which way a pattern of moving dots was traveling and respond with their choice. Despite their remarkable speed, they remained highly accurate.

Berdasarkan laporan, the findings, published in the journal science, offer new insight into how bird brains process information and make decisions. Researchers Philipp Schmidbauer and Professor Andreas Nieder from the University of Tübingen's Institute of Neurobiology found that the crows' rapid responses were accompanied by equally impressive activity in their brain cells.

Crows Make Rapid Decisions With Remarkable Accuracy.

Diungkapkan bahwa to test the birds' decision-making abilities, the researchers presented them with moving dots on a touchscreen. The crows had to determine whether most of the dots were traveling left or right, then indicate their answer by pecking a target on the corresponding side of the screen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the birds performed remarkably well, even when the direction of movement was difficult to identify. "Even when the patterns of motion were hard to recognize, the crows' decisions were still better than random choices," Philipp Schmidbauer reports, "and with clear signals, they achieved an accuracy of nearly 100 percent. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the results showed that crows could evaluate visual information and make accurate choices in a fraction of a second. To understand how their brains accomplished this, the researchers examined the activity of individual neurons as the birds completed the task.

Crow Brains Begin Processing Decisions in Just 70 Milliseconds.

Diungkapkan bahwa the team recorded neural activity in a part of the bird brain called the nidopallium caudolaterale. This region plays an important role in processing information and making decisions, much like the prefrontal cortex in the human brain.

Diungkapkan bahwa the recordings revealed that the crows' brains began distinguishing between the two possible directions almost immediately. Just 70 milliseconds after the moving dots appeared, neurons associated with the different choices were already showing distinct patterns of activity.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, these signals emerged well before the birds physically responded. As the crows evaluated the moving dots, neural activity steadily increased until it reached a threshold associated with making a decision. The activity reflected both how clearly the dots indicated a particular direction and which direction the bird ultimately selected.

Different Brain Structures, Similar Decision-Making Processes.

One of the most intriguing findings is that crows appear to make decisions using neural processes similar to those found in humans and other primates, even though their brains are organized very differently.

"These findings show that neuronal dynamics in the avian brain are consistent with established models of decision-making in humans and non-human primates," says Andreas Nieder.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike mammals, birds do not have a cerebral cortex organized into layers. Nevertheless, their brains appear capable of following the same fundamental principles for evaluating evidence and reaching decisions. In this visual task, the crows completed that process twice as quickly as primates.

Berdasarkan laporan, the researchers suggest that this exceptional speed could reflect the demands birds have faced throughout their evolution. Rapidly interpreting visual information and responding with precise movements are especially important for animals that fly and use their beaks to interact with their surroundings.

"Birds rely on their vision to carry out precise, rapid maneuvers during flight and to guide their beaks towards objects when foraging," Nieder explains.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, the exact biological mechanisms responsible for the crows' speed advantage remain unknown. Further studies will be needed to determine how their differently structured brains can make comparable visual decisions so much faster than those of humans and monkeys.

#144. Man's secret use of synthetic testosterone for cows nearly destroyed his heart

📅 12 Nov 2026

Man's secret use of synthetic testosterone for cows nearly destroyed his heart

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/health/2026/11/mans-secret-use-of-synthetic-testosterone-for-cows-nearly-destroyed-his-heart/

Doctors warn that such life-threatening cases are becoming more common.

Berdasarkan laporan, for 11 years, a massachusetts man had an alarming array of health problems, most notably that his heart kept failing. He landed in the hospital over and over again, needed life support at one point, spent years going to specialists, and underwent a barrage of tests along the way.

Sebagaimana diketahui, but through it all, he never revealed a key detail behind his ailments: he was taking powerful, illicit synthetic testosterone derivatives (aka anabolic-androgenic steroids, or aas). One of the drugs he took was approved only for use in animals; it’s primarily used to beef up cows.

Sebagaimana diketahui, left in the dark, his doctors had to puzzle this out on their own. In a case report in this week’s issue of the New England Journal of Medicine, they explain how they did it. They also offer a warning: These cases will only become more common, and clinicians need to know what they look like.

Berdasarkan laporan, “use of aas has now become a major international substance use disorder,” they wrote. In the US, it’s estimated that between 2. 9 and 4 million people, mostly male athletes, use AAS. To put this in a public health perspective, this is more than the number of people in the US with an HIV infection.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “clinicians should be prepared to encounter increasing numbers of patients presenting with the long-term effects of aas exposure, including cardiomyopathy, atherosclerotic disease, and anabolic steroid–induced hypogonadism. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, patients also need to be prepared for what recovery looks like, which they described as being “lengthy and varied. ” The man’s case offers a stark example.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the problems started when he was 39. He fell ill after returning from a trip to the Caribbean and went to Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston with a fever, chills, and trouble breathing. His heart only got worse from there, and within hours, he ended up on a type of life support called ECMO (venoarterial extracorporeal membrane oxygenation), a machine that does the work of both the heart and lungs in dire circumstances. Tests suggested he had an acute kidney injury, liver damage, and an injured heart. He luckily recovered—and quickly. Testing of his heart showed that the left chamber was pumping out just 21 percent of its blood in a beat (a normal amount is above 50 percent). But doctors were baffled by the cause.

Diungkapkan bahwa when he was weaned off ecmo a few days later, his heart function normalized. In rare instances, an infection with these germs can lead to a condition called poststreptococcal myocarditis, which could potentially explain some of his symptoms. It was their best guess. They found nothing but a mildly elevated level of antibodies against a toxin made by Streptococcus bacteria. Doctors looked for evidence of anything that could have sparked the sudden cardiac spiral. They prescribed him antibiotics, as well as drugs to lower his blood pressure.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, two years later, he went to another hospital. This time it was for acute pain in his abdomen and legs. There were also signs of inflammation in his blood vessels. The arteries that supply blood to his kidneys appeared narrowed, suggesting a condition called renal-artery stenosis. But the doctors at the hospital couldn’t pinpoint the problem. Doctors found signs of cell death in his kidneys. They prescribed him anti-inflammatory drugs and sent him on his way.

Berdasarkan laporan, for the next five years, the man started seeing a cadre of specialists to monitor his health, including doctors in primary care, cardiology, nephrology, rheumatology, general medicine, sleep medicine, and psychiatry. When he was about 46, he reported fatigue to his primary care doctor, who found that his testosterone level was low. The man then went to an endocrinologist, reporting not just fatigue but low libido and poor sleep. The endocrinologist recommended treatment for obstructive sleep apnea, which can increase the risk of low testosterone.

Berdasarkan laporan, a year later, the man added a hematologist to his rotation of care providers. The hematologist noted the man also had high blood pressure (150/108 mm Hg) but found everything else to be normal. A routine blood test revealed abnormally high levels of red blood cells (erythrocytosis). The hematologist ended up attributing the erythrocytosis to the man’s sleep apnea and renal-artery stenosis.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it wasn’t until he arrived again at mass general in 2026 that doctors finally put it all together. Now 50, the man was once again experiencing heart failure—and he had again just returned from the Caribbean.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the case report, doctors provided a more complete picture of the man, noting that he lived with his wife and children in eastern massachusetts, worked as a facilities manager, and described himself as a workout “fanatic. He told doctors he had erectile dysfunction and reduced libido for several years. ” He used tanning beds and applied spray tans. They also noticed that he had mildly enlarged breast tissue (a condition called gynecomastia), progressive insulin resistance, decreased levels of “good” cholesterol (HDL or high-density lipoprotein), and fatty liver disease.

Berdasarkan laporan, when he arrived at the hospital, he reported five days of worsening chest tightness and pressure, fatigue, swelling in his legs, and trouble breathing. Doctors described him as “muscular, tanned, anxious, and in mild distress. His heart was racing at 134 beats per minute. His blood pressure was high at 146/106 mm Hg. ” Tests showed his heart was once again failing, with the left chamber pumping out just 20 percent of its blood.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the doctors started reviewing a long list of possible explanations. They ruled out infectious diseases that can cause heart inflammation (myocarditis), as well as autoimmune conditions, medication side effects, and toxins. The explanation they were left with—which also seemed to explain much of his other problems—was high doses of testosterone, or perhaps an AAS.

Berdasarkan laporan, illicit use of aas is clearly linked to the heart problems, including the decreased blood pumping the man had, as well as strain and damage. It could also explain his enlarged breast tissue, fatty liver and signs of liver damage, progressive insulin resistance, kidney injuries, high blood pressure, and high levels of red blood cells (erythrocytosis). The sleep problems, fatigue, and low testosterone levels—which doctors previously guessed were from obstructive sleep apnea—could actually be from a drop in natural hormone production after doses of AAS (a condition called hypogonadism).

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, in the man’s lengthy medical history, he had never mentioned using aas or testosterone supplements. When they finally broached the topic, he confessed; he had been intermittently using high doses of AAS to boost his muscles, taking the most recent dose before his vacation to the Caribbean. Doctors prepared to have a delicate conversation to determine if he was secretly using the drugs. The testosterone derivative he used was trenbolone, an AAS only approved for use in veterinary medicine; it’s mostly used in livestock.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the doctors then tested his total testosterone level, finding it was so high that the test couldn’t accurately measure it. His level was over 1,500 ng/dl. The assay’s range of detection was 12 to 1,500 nanograms per deciliter of blood. The range considered normal for the test was between 249 and 836 ng/dl. The doctors gave their final diagnosis: androgen excess–related cardiomyopathy.

Berdasarkan laporan, the primary treatment for his heart is to stop taking aas. But recovery from the AAS-induced hypogonadism was a much longer, more difficult journey. Four months later, heart tests showed his left chamber was pumping 49 percent of its blood, a significant improvement. The state of his liver also improved. Doctors prescribed him medications for high blood pressure, heart failure, and diabetes. It was made harder because he was over age 35, had taken AAS for more than a decade, and had preexisting dysfunction.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, six months into his recovery, he still had significant hypogonadism symptoms, which include loss of sexual desire, erectile dysfunction, gynecomastia, reduced orgasmic satisfaction, and ejaculatory disorders. It didn’t work for the man. He moved on to trying topical testosterone-replacement therapy but continued to have erectile dysfunction. He opted to try a drug called clomiphene, which binds to estrogen receptors. It’s often used in women to help with fertility, but in men it is sometimes used to try to jumpstart natural testosterone production. Doctors warn that it could take up to three years for the hypogonadism to resolve.

In the last follow-up at eight months, he reported that he was still off AAS and had no symptoms of heart failure.

#145. A Global Rebound for Mangroves

📅 13 Nov 2026

A Global Rebound for Mangroves

Tanggal: 13 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://science.nasa.gov/earth/earth-observatory/a-global-rebound-for-mangroves/

After decades of decline, this ecologically significant type of forest is making a comeback.

Berdasarkan laporan, scientists began using satellites to map mangrove forests in the 1970s after the launch of the first landsat satellite. For decades, the story they told about mangroves was dominated by loss and decline. Research published in Science suggests that the tide has turned.

Diungkapkan bahwa a global rebound began around 2010, the scientists found, led by the expansion of mangrove forests in asia, australia, and south america. The researchers analyzed Landsat imagery collected between 1984 and 2023, looking for signs of changes in the extent and density of mangrove canopy.

Berdasarkan laporan, they tallied losses of nearly 3,000 square kilometers (1,200 square miles) between 1984 and 2010, followed by an unexpected increase of nearly 2,000 square kilometers (770 square miles) of mangroves after 2010. They also found that many of today's mangrove forests have denser, more closed canopies than they did in 2010, a sign of healthier, less degraded forests, particularly in South America.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "other research groups have mapped and analyzed long-term changes in select regions, but these are the first global mangrove maps that cover such a long period," said zhen zhang, an environmental scientist at tulane university. "About two-thirds of the expansion was due to mangroves colonizing new areas and the other third due to restoration and regrowth in degraded areas," he added.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one of the most notable reversals occurred in southeast asia—especially burma (myanmar). The country lost mangroves rapidly in the 1980s and 1990s due to the expansion of agriculture, aquaculture, and firewood harvesting in coastal areas, but the trend reversed around 2010, when mangrove area began expanding in many places. The authors attribute the turnaround to increased awareness and restoration efforts after the devastating Indian Ocean tsunami in 2004, strengthened legal protections for forests, and high rates of sedimentation that opened up new mudflats for colonization.

Berdasarkan laporan, the pair of landsat images above shows expansion of mangrove forests in palaw township in burma's myeik district—an area that has seen both significant regeneration of degraded mangrove forests and the spread of trees into new areas since 2010. 6 percent of its mangrove area between the 1980s and 2010. Despite the gains, deforestation remains a common challenge in Burma, which lost 28. In this region, much of the regeneration appears to be occurring in abandoned rice fields (brown) south of the village of Kyauktaung. People on nearby Pyin Bukyi Island, meanwhile, have experimented with conservation projects and tree planting efforts to support mangroves. Since then, the country's mangrove area has grown about 10 percent.

Berdasarkan laporan, mangrove trees are relatively small—averaging about 13 meters (43 feet)—but mighty from an ecological perspective, with mangrove ecosystems storing up to four times as much carbon as taller inland tropical forests. The trees play an important role in protecting coastal communities from erosion and storm surges, and their distinctive stilt-like roots provide habitat and vital nursery grounds for fish, shrimp, crabs, and other marine life.

Diungkapkan bahwa in several areas, such as around the mouth of the amazon river and in northern australia, extensive deposition of sediment has created new mudflats that mangroves have successfully colonized, contributing to steady increases in each of these regions since the 1990s. At the northern and southern edges of their range, including the southeastern U. S. , warming temperatures and fewer freezes have also allowed mangroves to push into areas that were previously too cold, Zhang explained.

Sebagaimana diketahui, there are some areas, however, where losses have outweighed gains. "This underscores that conservation and slowing deforestation can lead to huge positive impacts when coupled with natural expansion and regeneration. North America and southern Africa, meanwhile, have seen widespread degradation after tropical cyclones devastated broad swaths of mangroves. Substantial mangrove losses in the Niger Delta, for instance, have reduced the total mangrove area in West and Central Africa since 2010. "The global successes we've seen with mangroves during the past decade should not be seen as grounds for complacency," cautioned Zhang. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, a cyberattack at fireworks ai has exposed some of its customers’ data, the company has confirmed. Fireworks AI, a platform that developers use to access and use open AI models, said an attacker breached its cloud provider to gain access to a Fireworks development system, which allowed access to some of its customers’ data.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the company said in its latest security advisory that the cybercriminals took fireworks’ customers’ billing information and some datasets. Fireworks touts tens of thousands of customers worldwide using its platform, including legal tech company Harvey and AI company Cursor.

At least one confirmed affected customer is online document editor and notetaker Notion, which said in a disclosure that the breach affected around 1% of its own customers.

Diungkapkan bahwa notion said that fireworks alerted the company to a security incident and later confirmed that the hackers had stolen some notion customer data. On November 3, Notion said it disconnected its systems from Fireworks, deleted the data stored in its systems, and stopped all connectivity between the two.

Berdasarkan laporan, notion confirmed this week that the hackers took chat transcripts of its notion ai customers who used the “insights” feature. The company said that the transcripts include “any input to or output from the model that was written to the chat,” but added that much of the data was unattributable and could not be determined from which customer it was obtained.

The breach at Fireworks AI shows how tech companies are reliant on other tech providers for their own offerings, and how cyberattacks can, as a result, spill over into other customers.

Berdasarkan laporan, fireworks said that it believes the hackers are financially motivated and that their goals are focused on selling tokens from breaching access to large language models, or llms. These schemes rely on selling to unauthorized third parties, who can burn through AI model usage without using their own resources.

This is the second breach affecting Fireworks in as many months, following a security incident in October.

#149. Where are all the males? Ancient human fossils reveal a startling mystery

📅 11 Nov 2026

Where are all the males? Ancient human fossils reveal a startling mystery

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261110042558.htm

Berdasarkan laporan, deep inside south africa's rising star cave system, scientists have uncovered a surprising clue about an extinct human relative that lived hundreds of thousands of years ago. For the first time, researchers have recovered and studied ancient proteins from Homo naledi fossils, revealing evidence that the cave may have contained an exclusively female burial site.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the discovery, published in the journal cell, raises an extraordinary possibility. The cave could represent the earliest known burial location reserved for one sex by a human relative other than Homo sapiens.

Diungkapkan bahwa homo naledi lived approximately 335,000 to 241,000 years ago and has fascinated scientists since its discovery in 2013. This extinct species combined primitive features resembling those of apes with other characteristics more closely associated with modern humans.

A Strange Mystery Hidden in Ancient Human Fossils.

Berdasarkan laporan, one of the biggest puzzles surrounding homo naledi involves the remarkably similar appearance of adult fossils recovered from the cave's dinaledi chamber. For more than a decade, researchers have struggled to explain why these individuals showed so little of the physical variation normally associated with differences between males and females.

To investigate, an international research team involving the University of York, the University of Copenhagen, and more than 10 other institutions turned to proteins preserved in the ancient remains.

Diungkapkan bahwa the scientists used a technique involving gentle acid etching to recover tiny protein fragments known as peptides from fossilized tooth enamel. This approach allowed them to collect samples while minimizing damage to the valuable fossils. In total, they examined 23 teeth belonging to at least 20 different individuals.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the researchers specifically searched for amelogenin-y, a protein produced from a gene on the male y chromosome. Surprisingly, they found no evidence of this male-specific marker.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to verify that their findings were reliable, specialists at the university of york's chemistry facility examined the amino acids in the samples. Their analysis confirmed that the proteins were genuinely ancient rather than the result of contamination from modern sources.

Could Homo naledi Have Had an All-Female Burial Site?.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, dr. Marc Dickinson, from the University of York's Department of Chemistry, said: "The lack of male markers with the group is truly fascinating. It is incredibly exciting to gain a window not only into the biology of our ancestors, but also into how they lived.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "these findings offer rare insights into a culture that has, until now, been difficult to access directly. Advances in ancient protein analysis are opening the door to a far richer and more nuanced understanding of ancient hominins. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, the results raise important questions about how homo naledi individuals lived, organized their communities, and treated their dead. If the Dinaledi Chamber was intentionally used only for females, it could point to surprisingly elaborate social customs among these ancient human relatives.

Such a practice might even suggest symbolic burial traditions once believed to be exclusive to Homo sapiens, or modern humans.

However, the researchers emphasize that an all-female burial site is not the only possible interpretation of the evidence.

Berdasarkan laporan, another explanation involves the genetics of homo naledi itself. If the population lived in extreme isolation, the gene responsible for producing Amelogenin-Y could have undergone a mutation or disappeared entirely.

Under that scenario, some of the individuals could actually have been male, even though their teeth did not contain the protein normally used to identify them.

Ancient Tooth Enamel Opens a New Window Into Human Evolution.

The ability to recover proteins from fossils this old is particularly valuable because tooth enamel can protect biological material for extraordinarily long periods.

Palesa Madupe, who carried out the research during her postdoctoral work at the University of Copenhagen, explained why teeth offer such an important source of evidence.

"Unlike those found in other remains like bone fragments, proteins in tooth enamel are preserved because dental enamel -- the hardest tissue in the human body -- shields proteins from environmental contamination even for millions of years.

Berdasarkan laporan, "this makes them ideal carriers of genetic information from deep time. Our study helps in the long-standing mystery of why Homo naledi lacked significant variation; it's probably because they could have all belonged to one sex. ".

The research represents the largest collection of individuals from an extinct hominin species ever examined using ancient protein analysis.

Diungkapkan bahwa whether the fossils belong entirely to females or include males with an unusual genetic signature, the discovery provides an important new perspective on homo naledi. It also demonstrates how proteins preserved in ancient teeth can reveal clues about extinct human relatives that their bones alone cannot provide.

As researchers continue investigating the mystery, the findings could reshape our understanding of the social lives and possible burial traditions of ancient human species.

Diungkapkan bahwa for katie spicer, embracing opportunity and challenge has led to giant leaps during her time at nasa. Spicer has spent her career looking at the small details in the big picture.

Berdasarkan laporan, after earning a bachelor’s degree in microbiology from the pennsylvania state university in state college, spicer spent several years working as a full-time homemaker and raising three children. Now, when she looks at the Moon in the night sky, Spicer says she’s humbled and honored to be part of the team that’s sending astronauts back to the lunar surface.

#152. The amazing disappearing exoplanet

📅 12 Nov 2026

The amazing disappearing exoplanet

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/science/2026/11/the-amazing-disappearing-exoplanet/

An exoplanet seems to have stopped transiting in front of its host star.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, one nice thing about discovering exoplanets is that, once you work out how long their orbits take, they continue to show up like clockwork. The timing is so regular, in fact, that we can use variations to detect the gravitational influence of additional planets in the same exosolar system. And the precise timing is useful in that we can rely on it to point telescopes at the system when we know some of the light we detect has passed through the planet’s atmosphere.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, on monday, researchers reported on an exoplanet that simply stopped showing up. TOI-2535b is a hot Jupiter-sized planet we’ve been observing as it transits between its host star, TOI-2535, and Earth for about seven years now. But it recently stopped showing up, and researchers suspect that’s due to an unseen companion orbiting in a different plane.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, toi-2535 is one of the many stars with exoplanet candidates identified by tess, the transiting exoplanet survey satellite. And TESS found signs of a Jupiter-sized planet orbiting it every eight days, an orbit close enough to make TOI-2535b a “hot Jupiter” exoplanet. It’s a K dwarf, meaning it’s somewhat smaller than the Sun. At that point, there was nothing especially unusual about it.

Diungkapkan bahwa but a closer look at the data showed two very strange things. First, the timing of when its transits occurred could shift by as much as six hours, a substantial variation for an orbit this brief. That’s typically a sign of gravitational interactions with another planet; depending on the details of that second planet’s orbit, it may slow the first one or accelerate it through a transit more quickly. Since the second planet doesn’t show up in TESS data, it appears to orbit in a slightly different plane, so it doesn’t pass between its host star and Earth.

Diungkapkan bahwa the second oddity is that the transit duration grew progressively shorter in more recent observations. This suggests that, while early observations saw the planet transiting across the star’s equator, later ones involved transits near one of the poles, ensuring that the planet spent less time between the star and Earth. This trend eventually reached its logical end point: TOI-2535b simply stopped transiting in the most recent observations.

Berdasarkan laporan, obviously, gravitational interactions with a planet orbiting in a different plane could potentially alter toi-2535b’s orbit so it no longer passes between toi-2535 and earth. There is also some precedent for the converse happening: a star around which no transits were originally detected but where transits began appearing in later observations. Still, as a Jupiter-sized planet, TOI-2535b should not be that easy to shift, and as the researchers note, “This is the fastest rate of inclination change observed for an exoplanet orbiting a single star. ”.

Diungkapkan bahwa the second, unseen planet “would need to be either extremely massive or on a highly eccentric orbit,” the researchers noted. So they decided to figure out what sorts of configurations could lead to such rapid changes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, to do so, they modeled 300,000 different starting configurations and ran them forward in time. They found there wasn’t a single favored configuration; as long as the planets were in an orbital resonance, things were relatively stable, at least over relatively short periods. So they took the 100 best solutions and ran them forward for a million years.

Diungkapkan bahwa about two-thirds became unstable during that period, which ruled out a couple of the potential resonances. The second is that the angle between the orbits of the two planets can’t be that large. The remaining third shared a couple of features. One is that the second, undetected planet has to be pretty massive—roughly Saturn-sized at a minimum. If it is, the difference would shrink over time, causing their orbits to become increasingly eccentric. Eventually, this results in a close approach between the two planets, followed by instability.

The University of California, Los Angeles has posted a video of one of the better models if you’re having a hard time visualizing all of this.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while a second planet hasn’t been detected via the transit method, its gravitational pull on the star should create changes in the radial velocity we could potentially detect. Right now, however, we don’t have enough clean data to detect it. The researchers also say there’s enough noise in the transit timing variations that a third planet in the system can’t be excluded.

Diungkapkan bahwa the question we probably can’t answer with further observations is how this system got into its current state. Large planets are thought to form farther out from the star and then migrate inward because of friction caused by the gas in the planet-forming disk. ) But this friction should also limit the angle between the planets’ orbits. (This inward motion tends to stop when orbital resonances develop. Without some additional event that mixed up the orbits, it’s not obvious how this system could have come to be.

Diungkapkan bahwa the astrophysical journal letters, 2026. DOI: 10. 3847/2041-8213/aeb4a4  (About DOIs).
