#236. NASA reveals bold new plan to return astronauts to the Moon in 2028

📅 09 Nov 2026

NASA reveals bold new plan to return astronauts to the Moon in 2028

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261108233054.htm

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nasa has revealed new details about its accelerated effort to return american astronauts to the moon in 2028. The updated strategy includes testing two competing lunar landers, streamlining rocket preparations, and introducing a lighter spacesuit to help make the first moonwalks possible sooner.

Sebagaimana diketahui, during an october 23 briefing, nasa administrator jared isaacman and other agency leaders outlined the next steps for the artemis program. The revised approach centers on two major missions: Artemis III, a test flight scheduled for 2027, and Artemis IV, which is intended to land astronauts on the lunar surface in 2028.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the announcement builds on priorities introduced earlier this year through nasa's ignition initiative. Agency officials also highlighted recent progress in spacecraft development, mission preparations, and partnerships with private aerospace companies. These efforts are intended to reduce technical risks, accelerate the schedule, and establish the foundation for a lasting American presence on the Moon.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "this is a very energized nasa, and these updates are only a small part of that story. "NASA is driving outcomes to make Moon missions a reality, and we're not waiting for others to bring their plans to us -- the campaign must move with urgency as strategic competitors pursue a permanent presence beyond Earth. We are bringing extreme focus to the mission to ensure delivery of world-changing outcomes as quickly, safely, affordably, and successfully as possible," said Isaacman. ".

Artemis III Will Test Two Lunar Landers in Earth Orbit.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, before attempting another crewed moon landing, nasa plans to conduct a major rehearsal in earth orbit. The Artemis III mission will bring together NASA's Orion spacecraft and experimental lunar landers developed by SpaceX and Blue Origin.

Diungkapkan bahwa four astronauts will travel aboard orion, launching on nasa's powerful sls (space launch system) rocket. During the planned 14-day mission, the crew will practice rendezvous and docking procedures with both companies' lander test vehicles. Rendezvous involves guiding two spacecraft to meet in orbit, while docking allows them to connect so astronauts can move between vehicles.

These demonstrations are designed to verify important spacecraft capabilities before Artemis IV attempts to carry astronauts to the Moon's surface.

Diungkapkan bahwa the tests will take place in a carefully planned sequence. Blue Origin will first launch a test version of its Blue Moon lander into Earth orbit. NASA will then send Orion and its four astronauts into space aboard the SLS rocket, where Orion will rendezvous and dock with the Blue Moon vehicle.

Diungkapkan bahwa next, spacex will launch a test version of its version 3 starship lunar lander. Orion will separate from Blue Moon and perform another docking maneuver, this time with Starship. By testing both systems during a single crewed mission, NASA aims to gather essential operational experience while reducing uncertainties before the 2028 landing attempt.

NASA Cuts Rocket Preparation Times and Costs.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the new mission details follow other recent artemis progress reports. According to NASA, the hardware needed for Artemis III remains on schedule, and improvements in processing have reduced preparation timelines by approximately 50%.

Berdasarkan laporan, the agency also reported a significant engineering achievement involving a critical rocket fuel-line component. Rather than relying on an outside supplier, NASA engineers redesigned, manufactured, and tested the component themselves in just five months. The work cost roughly one-tenth of an earlier estimate from an external vendor.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "nasa should be expected to do this kind of work, and we have some of the best technical knowledge in the world on rocket hardware and operations to do it," said jeremy parsons, the agency's artemis program manager. "It's an example of how we are rebuilding our core competencies and developing centers of excellence in technical functions instead of continuing to outsource expertise. ".

The improvements reflect NASA's broader effort to strengthen its internal engineering capabilities, shorten development schedules, and reduce the cost of preparing missions for launch.

SpaceX and Blue Origin Offer Different Paths to the Moon.

Berdasarkan laporan, for artemis iv in 2028, nasa intends to launch astronauts aboard orion using the sls rocket from kennedy space center in florida. Once in space, the crew will rely on a lunar landing system developed by either SpaceX or Blue Origin to reach the Moon's surface.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, both companies have revised their original mission designs to make operations simpler, more efficient, and more adaptable. Although they share the same objective, their approaches to transporting astronauts to the lunar surface differ considerably.

Sebagaimana diketahui, spacex plans to use its starship spacecraft, which will take on additional propellant while orbiting earth. After refueling, Starship will meet Orion and carry the spacecraft toward the Moon. Refueling in orbit is an important part of SpaceX's strategy because it allows the vehicle to receive the propellant needed for its journey after leaving the launchpad.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, blue origin is developing a different approach using its blue moon mark 2 lander. Its plan calls for additional propulsion stages in Earth orbit to send the lander toward the Moon. The lander will then meet Orion in a relatively low lunar orbit before carrying astronauts down to the surface.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, both companies are working toward having their systems ready to support a crewed moon landing in 2028. Maintaining two potential landing systems gives NASA greater flexibility as development and testing continue.

NASA Explores New Rocket Options for Artemis IV.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nasa is also considering two possible upper stages for the sls rocket used on artemis iv. An upper stage is the portion of a rocket that provides additional propulsion after the earlier stages have completed their work, helping send a spacecraft toward its destination.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one option is the interim cryogenic propulsion stage already used by sls. The other is an extended version of United Launch Alliance's Centaur V upper stage, which would hold additional propellant.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by developing both possibilities, nasa hopes to preserve flexibility in its launch plans and avoid becoming dependent on a single technical solution. Having alternatives could help the agency respond to engineering challenges without jeopardizing the broader Moon landing schedule.

A New Lightweight Spacesuit Could Speed Up Moonwalks.

Another important change involves the spacesuits astronauts will wear while exploring the lunar surface.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, nasa is working with axiom space on a second, lighter design known as the "sortie suit. " The new suit is intended specifically for the first Moon surface excursions and weighs approximately half as much as Axiom's larger primary spacesuit.

The lighter design could simplify preparations for the earliest landing missions and help astronauts begin exploring the lunar surface sooner.

Sebagaimana diketahui, however, the sortie suit is not intended to replace the primary design. Axiom's more capable suit will remain part of NASA's plans for future missions that require longer periods outside the spacecraft and more demanding surface activities.

Building a Permanent Human Presence on the Moon.

NASA's ambitions extend well beyond returning astronauts to the lunar surface for a single mission.

Berdasarkan laporan, as the artemis program advances, the agency intends to send crews on increasingly challenging expeditions near the moon's south pole. This region is an important focus of future lunar exploration, and the missions are designed to expand how much of the Moon humans can investigate directly.

Diungkapkan bahwa nasa describes the effort as part of a new golden age of innovation and exploration. The agency expects its lunar missions to support scientific discoveries, generate economic benefits, and encourage the development of technologies needed for more ambitious space exploration.

Sebagaimana diketahui, ultimately, the goal is to establish an enduring human presence on the moon rather than repeat the brief visits of earlier lunar expeditions. The experience gained from operating spacecraft, supporting astronauts, and carrying out increasingly complex missions on the lunar surface will also help NASA prepare for another historic objective: sending the first astronauts to Mars.

#237. Trump admin loses fight to spy on random journalists’ LinkedIn DMs

📅 11 Nov 2026

Trump admin loses fight to spy on random journalists’ LinkedIn DMs

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/11/trump-admin-loses-fight-to-spy-on-random-journalists-linkedin-dms/

Confidential sources “lifeblood” of free press, court rules in LinkedIn fight.

The Trump administration’s fight to stop suspected leaks of top-secret military information on LinkedIn can’t sweep in “a vast number of confidential sources” of random journalists “who have no conceivable relationship” to the Department of Justice’s investigation, an appeals court ruled Tuesday.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the order came after the doj asked linkedin to turn over 18 months of communications from targeted journalists who collectively published more than 1,000 articles on many different topics over that time period. The request was not limited to journalists involved in a controversial report from a news outlet that Trump said exposed confidential military information in a foreign country. (The outlet is not being named to protect national security secrets. ) Instead, the DOJ cast a wide net, requesting extensive LinkedIn data on journalists who had any possible link to the journalists around the time the report was drafted.

Berdasarkan laporan, the majority of journalists have linkedin accounts and publish their contact information to encourage sources to connect on the platform, linkedin argued. So allowing that government overreach went beyond harming targeted journalists and threatened to undermine a critical platform where journalists frequently connect with confidential sources, judges ruled. Even more concerning, the Trump administration secured a secrecy order barring LinkedIn from telling anyone about the sweeping request for a year. That left journalists unaware for far too long that their First Amendment rights had been compromised, judges ruled.

Diungkapkan bahwa penning the unanimous opinion from a three-judge panel, ronald reagan-nominated judge j. Harvie Wilkinson III rejected LinkedIn’s request to quash the order entirely and ordered the US district court to substantially narrow the order to avoid posing a grave threat to press freedoms.

Berdasarkan laporan, without such an intervention, the us risked silencing dissidents who raise alarms about “events of large importance and governmental behavior of dubious legality and integrity,” wilkinson wrote. “A request by the government to scoop up reporters’ records wholesale and ascertain the identity of their sources would tip the balance against informed discourse in a manner inimical to democratic health. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “many of the users identified have no conceivable relationship to the leak investigation,” wilkinson wrote. “Instead, they are affiliated with media outlets, universities, and law firms which may have been relevant to the host of other stories the targeted journalists were investigating during the same considerable time period. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, as wilkinson explained, the district court failed to consider linkedin’s claims that the request imposed undue burdens and threatened the first amendment rights of users who would have no way of knowing that their communications were being reviewed by the government. The lower court reasoned that the request imposed no burden on LinkedIn because the company could feasibly respond to it, then ruled that, regardless of how these matters were weighed, the balance would tip toward the government’s interest in obtaining the LinkedIn data.

This was an error that must be corrected, the appeals court ruled.

Berdasarkan laporan, “it is not appropriate for district courts to approve requests purely because the records requested are logistically feasible to compile,” wilkinson wrote. There is space under law for both. He further emphasized that “serious security and speech claims are in tension in this case. ”.

Berdasarkan laporan, the appeals court has ordered the district court to go back and assess how the disclosure order can be narrowed. That includes entertaining a very limited alternative to the government’s secrecy order that LinkedIn had proposed—which would have notified a single attorney of the news outlet under investigation about the government’s request.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the trump administration fought that limited request, arguing that the news outlet’s attorney may not be trustworthy or could possibly tip others off to the linkedin probe, but wilkinson rejected those arguments. Noting that the justice system often deals with “imperfectly informed litigants,” Wilkinson said that “the government should be given an opportunity to explain why LinkedIn’s narrow disclosure would somehow compromise its investigation. ”.

“Unless the government’s response to LinkedIn’s proposal is more persuasive than anything the government has presented thus far, LinkedIn’s narrow exception to the breadth of the Secrecy Order must be adopted,” Wilkinson wrote.

Diungkapkan bahwa linkedin, which is owned by microsoft, does not seem to expect the government to be able to defend the sweeping request on remand. In a statement, a Microsoft spokesperson told Ars that “this is an important ruling for the right to privacy and press freedom. While a narrowed order may not protect all irrelevant users from being caught in the government’s hunt for the military leaker, it would stop Trump from accessing a broad range of journalists’ interactions with confidential sources. ”.

“Microsoft has consistently defended journalists’ ability to protect confidential sources and the principle that government demands for information should face meaningful judicial scrutiny and be balanced against First Amendment protections,” Microsoft’s spokesperson said.

Diungkapkan bahwa several civil rights groups backed linkedin in the fight, including the reporters committee for freedom of the press (rcfp). In a statement to Ars, RCFP President Bruce D. Brown celebrated the ruling as a win for all journalists, not just those who rely on LinkedIn to connect with confidential sources.

Berdasarkan laporan, “this ruling is a big deal and will quickly become one of the leading opinions in the area—one we will be quoting from it for a long time,” brown said. “The court recognized that confidential sources are the ‘lifeblood’ of investigative reporting and that dragnet demands from technology companies to reveal those sources violate the law. ”.

After all, you don’t need to know everything, only what’s important.

Moderna on Friday smashed third-quarter revenue and earnings estimates and hiked its outlook for full-year sales growth, as some of its newer products gain momentum and Covid vaccine revenue outperforms.

Shares of Moderna rose roughly 3% in premarket trading on Friday.

The biotech company now expects 2026 revenue growth of 15% to 25%, up from its previous guidance of up to 10%.

"The new product and the diversification of geography is what has led to such a strong Q3," Moderna CEO Stéphane Bancel said in an interview ahead of the results.

Diungkapkan bahwa for example, he said the company is seeing the "full-year impact" of its next-generation mrna covid vaccine, which won u. approval in May 2025. S. Bancel noted that Covid is a seasonal business and vaccine contracts are typically established in the first quarter, so Moderna's shot only had a "small launch" to start with last year.

Sebagaimana diketahui, moderna's new stand-alone flu shot, which was approved in the u. S. in August, will similarly have a "limited launch" in the country in 2026 given the timing, he said.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in a separate interview on cnbc's "squawk box," bancel said moderna's geographic expansion in canada, the u. K. and Asia helped boost results. The company's work to lower costs also resulted in a profit in the quarter, he added.

"It's the sales that are stronger and the costs that are also lower," Bancel said.

Here's what Moderna reported for the third quarter compared with what Wall Street was expecting, based on a survey of analysts by LSEG:.

Sebagaimana diketahui, moderna's third-quarter revenue jumped 29% to $1. 31 billion, boosted by higher Covid vaccine sales in international markets and helped by deliveries under long-term government partnerships. S. Revenue was $780 million in the U. and $533 million in international markets.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the company posted a net income of $162 million, or 38 cents per share, for the third quarter. That compares with a net loss of $200 million, or a loss of 51 cents per share, reported for the year-ago period.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the results come weeks after moderna and merck unveiled promising late-stage data on their experimental personalized cancer vaccine in combination with immunotherapy keytruda in certain melanoma patients. Despite the positive results, investors battered Moderna's stock after part of the data was leaked on social media just days before trial investigators were set to present it at a European medical conference.

Sebagaimana diketahui, bancel called it a "surprising reaction," but said that the companies also saw a positive response from others on wall street, including long-term investors and analysts who examined the full data in depth. He added that the doctors in the field "were so impressed with the data," and many expressed that they hope to use it in their day-to-day practice.

Moderna's stock has skyrocketed more than 700% this year, largely on optimism about the potential for the shot.

#243. After 40 years, CERN finds evidence of a one-in-10-billion particle decay

📅 10 Nov 2026

After 40 years, CERN finds evidence of a one-in-10-billion particle decay

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261108233047.htm

Berdasarkan laporan, after more than 40 years of searching, physicists at cern have reached a major milestone in their hunt for one of the rarest known particle decays. Researchers working with the LHCb experiment have detected evidence of a process expected to occur only once in approximately 10 billion beauty particle decays.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the finding, announced during a seminar at cern, marks the first time a single experiment has produced sufficient evidence for this extraordinarily rare event. Beyond its rarity, the decay is particularly valuable because it could help scientists investigate particles that are too massive to be created directly in the Large Hadron Collider.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, at the center of the discovery is a particle called bd, which contains a beauty quark and a down antiquark. Muons are similar to electrons but have greater mass. Scientists found evidence that this particle can decay into a pair of muons (μ+μ-). The results agree with predictions from the Standard Model, the leading theory describing fundamental particles and their interactions, and help narrow the possibilities for new particles beyond it.

Why Rare Particle Decays Could Reveal New Physics.

Berdasarkan laporan, one reason physicists are so interested in these unusual decays is that quantum effects allow other particles to influence how they occur. Even particles too heavy to be produced in the Large Hadron Collider can potentially leave subtle traces in the rates of these processes.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by measuring extremely rare decays with high precision, researchers can look for differences between experimental results and theoretical predictions. Such discrepancies could provide indirect evidence of previously unknown particles. Generally, the rarer a decay is, the more sensitive it can be to these hidden influences.

Diungkapkan bahwa the decay known as bd → μ+μ-belongs to a special category that physicists have long considered 'golden channels' for investigating physics beyond the standard model. During this process, a beauty quark and an antiquark with the opposite electric charge annihilate each other. Their energy is transformed into a muon and its antiparticle.

Berdasarkan laporan, scientists have previously observed a related process involving a different beauty particle, called bs. In 2015, a joint analysis by the LHCb and CMS collaborations reported the first confirmed observation of Bs → μ+μ-, along with initial evidence for the much rarer Bd decay.

Berdasarkan laporan, however, subsequent analyses incorporating data collected through 2018 could not confirm the earlier evidence for bd → μ+μ-. The difference in rarity is substantial. The Bs decay occurs approximately three times per billion beauty particle decays, while the Bd process is predicted to happen about 30 times less frequently.

Upgraded CERN Detector Makes the Breakthrough Possible.

A significant improvement to the LHCb experiment helped researchers overcome the enormous difficulty of detecting such a rare event.

Sebagaimana diketahui, following a major upgrade, the experiment began collecting data in 2024 at five times the rate achieved between 2010 and 2018. The upgraded detector also became better at identifying different kinds of particles, giving researchers a clearer picture of the activity produced during collisions.

Berdasarkan laporan, the team combined these improvements with machine learning techniques to distinguish the exceptionally rare signals from the vast number of other particle processes. Without these advances, the events scientists wanted to study would have been overwhelmed by the background.

Diungkapkan bahwa "physicists have been chasing this decay for more than forty years," said marco santimaria, who co-led the international analysis team of 19 scientists. "Extreme precision is required to pick the muons out of the overwhelming background. ".

Four Decades of Searching Finally Produce Strong Evidence.

In particle physics, scientists use a statistical measure called standard deviations to evaluate how likely an apparent signal is to result from random fluctuations rather than a genuine physical process.

Berdasarkan laporan, a result must reach three standard deviations to qualify as evidence of a new phenomenon. At that level, the probability of random fluctuations producing a signal at least as statistically extreme is approximately 0. 3%.

Diungkapkan bahwa using data collected during 2024 and 2025, the lhcb researchers identified evidence of bd → μ+μ- at a significance of 3. 0 standard deviations. When they combined those measurements with earlier data gathered between 2011 and 2018, the statistical significance increased to 3. 2 standard deviations, exceeding the widely accepted threshold for evidence.

The same investigation also produced the most precise measurements ever obtained for the related Bs → μ+μ-decay, providing additional information about these exceptionally uncommon processes.

Diungkapkan bahwa although the new findings represent a major achievement, physicists have not yet reached the threshold required to declare a confirmed observation. That milestone requires a significance of five standard deviations.

If future measurements achieve that level of certainty, Bd → μ+μ-would become the rarest beauty particle decay ever observed.

Future Large Hadron Collider Upgrades Could Uncover Hidden Particles.

Researchers expect upcoming improvements to the Large Hadron Collider to make these measurements even more powerful.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the high luminosity lhc, also known as the hilumi lhc, is scheduled to begin operating in 2030. Another major upgrade to the LHCb experiment is planned for the middle of the following decade. Together, these developments could eventually increase the experiment's data collection rate by another factor of ten.

Sebagaimana diketahui, collecting much larger datasets would allow physicists to detect more of these extremely rare decays and measure their properties with greater precision. That increased sensitivity could make it possible to identify subtle effects associated with particles that remain beyond the direct reach of existing accelerators.

"Seeing evidence of this rare decay is incredibly exciting, opening up new possibilities to probe beyond the direct reach of the LHC," explained Harry Cliff, LHCb's Rare Decays Convener and Analysis Co-lead.

Berdasarkan laporan, "the future lhcb upgrade will allow us to observe many more of these decays, providing even greater sensitivity to undiscovered particles. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, for physicists who have pursued this elusive signal for more than four decades, the new evidence represents a long-awaited advance. It also offers a promising way to investigate whether the known laws of particle physics are part of a much larger picture.

#247. A radical theory says the universe is twice as old as we thought

📅 11 Nov 2026

A radical theory says the universe is twice as old as we thought

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261108233040.htm

Sebagaimana diketahui, a radical alternative to the standard picture of the cosmos is gaining attention after researchers at the university of ottawa reported that it successfully matched several important astronomical observations. The model suggests that the Universe could be 26. 7 billion years old, nearly twice the widely accepted age of 13. 8 billion years, and that neither dark matter nor dark energy is needed to explain its behavior.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, if further research supports these findings, the theory could offer a very different explanation for how the universe evolved. It may also help resolve one of modern astronomy's most puzzling discoveries: the existence of surprisingly large and mature galaxies at a time when the conventional model suggests they should barely have begun forming.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, throughout 2025 and 2026, rajendra gupta, an adjunct professor in the university of ottawa's department of physics, and postdoctoral researcher dr. Nikolaos Samaras evaluated an alternative cosmological framework known as CCC+TL against several major astronomical observations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the name stands for “covarying coupling constants plus tired light. ” Rather than relying on dark matter and dark energy, the model proposes that some of the effects attributed to these mysterious components could result from changes over time in fundamental physical constants. These constants help determine how particles and forces interact.

Sebagaimana diketahui, for decades, astronomers have searched for direct evidence of dark matter and dark energy. Dark energy is the name given to whatever is causing the expansion of the Universe to accelerate. Dark matter is thought to provide additional gravity that helps explain how galaxies move and how large cosmic structures hold together. Although extensive observations support their gravitational and cosmological effects, neither component has been directly identified.

Berdasarkan laporan, the prevailing cosmological framework, called λcdm, incorporates both. Despite its success in explaining a wide range of observations, it faces questions raised by the discovery of unexpectedly developed galaxies in the early Universe.

Berdasarkan laporan, “most emerging models explain only a limited set of observations,” professor gupta says. “A new model must not conflict with the pillars of cosmology and astrophysics, and our findings meet that challenge, including the yet-to-be-published Cosmic Microwave Background challenge. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, testing such a fundamentally different theory requires more than adjusting the standard model. CCC+TL modifies the Einstein and Friedmann equations, which describe gravity and how the Universe expands. As a result, Gupta and Samaras had to develop equations and computer programs specifically adapted to their model for each test.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the researchers report that ccc+tl produced results consistent with several major astronomical measurements. One important test involved the light elements created shortly after the Big Bang, including hydrogen and helium. The alternative model predicted abundances that matched those calculated using the standard cosmological framework.

Diungkapkan bahwa it also agreed with cosmic chronometer measurements, which allow astronomers to reconstruct the history of cosmic expansion by comparing the ages of galaxies at different distances. These measurements provide an independent way to examine how the expansion rate has changed over billions of years.

Berdasarkan laporan, another significant test focused on the motion of galaxies. In a recent study published in Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society, the researchers examined all 175 galaxies in the SPARC database. They found that their model could reproduce the observed rotation curves without invoking dark matter.

Berdasarkan laporan, rotation curves describe how quickly stars and gas orbit at different distances from the centers of galaxies. Under conventional gravity, the visible matter alone generally cannot explain these motions, which is one of the major reasons scientists believe dark matter exists.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the team also investigated time dilation in observations of supernovae. Time dilation refers to the apparent stretching of events over time when viewed across vast cosmic distances. Their analysis offered additional support for CCC+TL, although the research paper remains under review.

The researchers also examined the Bullet Cluster, a famous system of colliding galaxy clusters that provides some of the strongest observational evidence for dark matter.

Sebagaimana diketahui, in this system, most of the ordinary matter is concentrated in extremely hot gas that emits x-rays. However, observations show that much of the gravitational effect is associated with the galaxies rather than the gas. The standard explanation is that invisible dark matter passed through the collision along with the galaxies.

Berdasarkan laporan, under ccc+tl, the additional gravitational effect predicted by the model also follows the galaxies instead of the hot gas, but without requiring dark matter. The researchers emphasize that this result is only an initial proof of concept and that more detailed investigations are necessary.

“Observations attributed to dark matter and dark energy likely originate from covarying coupling constants,” adds Professor Gupta, who examines this possibility further in a separate paper exploring the origin of dark matter and dark energy.

Perhaps the most intriguing implication of the model involves the earliest galaxies ever observed.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, astronomers using the james webb space telescope have discovered galaxies that appear surprisingly massive and mature for their early place in cosmic history. Their existence has prompted questions about how quickly stars and galaxies could have formed after the Big Bang.

CCC+TL offers a possible answer by giving the early Universe substantially more time to develop.

Diungkapkan bahwa in the standard cosmological model, the universe was approximately 300 million years old during the period known as cosmic dawn, when the first generations of stars and galaxies were emerging. At the same observed redshift, however, CCC+TL would place the Universe's age at roughly 4. 6 billion years.

Berdasarkan laporan, redshift measures how much light from a distant object has shifted toward longer, redder wavelengths. Astronomers use it to study distant galaxies and investigate earlier stages of cosmic history.

Diungkapkan bahwa under the alternative model, galaxies observed at extremely high redshifts would have had billions of additional years to grow. The researchers calculate that early galaxies would be approximately 12 times larger in both size and mass than predicted by standard cosmology, according to findings published in Galaxies 13, 115.

Diungkapkan bahwa “impossible early galaxies become predictable galaxies,” professor gupta explains. “We predict that galaxies exist well beyond the distances the James Webb Space Telescope has reached. ”.

Upcoming observations could provide an important opportunity to investigate this prediction.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the james webb space telescope's glimpse program aims to search for extremely distant galaxies, potentially reaching redshifts greater than 50. These observations would probe an exceptionally early period in the Universe's history under the standard cosmological framework.

Berdasarkan laporan, according to conventional models, there may not have been enough time for large galaxies to assemble at such extreme redshifts. The CCC+TL model does not impose the same restriction because its cosmic timeline allows substantially more time for galaxies to develop.

Berdasarkan laporan, finding galaxies at these distances could therefore provide another important way to compare the competing explanations. However, such discoveries would not, by themselves, establish that the alternative model is correct.

Diungkapkan bahwa although the researchers report encouraging results across several major cosmological tests, ccc+tl remains an unconventional proposal that requires further independent examination. The standard cosmological model continues to explain a broad range of astronomical observations, and any replacement must ultimately demonstrate comparable or greater success.

For Gupta, the latest findings provide a reason to continue investigating the possibility that the Universe operates differently than scientists currently assume.

Diungkapkan bahwa “the success should encourage astronomers to take the new model seriously. It is challenging to understand and apply, but we believe it extends the physics of the Universe beyond ΛCDM limits,” concludes Professor Gupta.

Berdasarkan laporan, flight 15's 75-minute launch window opens at 5:45 p. EST (2245 GMT) on Nov. 13. Diungkapkan bahwa "as it launches towards the southeast, and it will be daylight, then the prospects for viewing from the u. are going to be in Texas and the states along the Gulf of Mexico," Robert Massey, deputy executive director at the Royal Astronomical Society, told Space. Diungkapkan bahwa if all goes to plan, starship's super heavy booster will propel the ship upper stage through the densest part of earth's atmosphere before returning to starbase for a powered landing and capture via the "chopstick" arms of the "mechazilla" tower system. Ship, meanwhile, will go on to orbit Earth approximately 14 times over the following 22 hours, during which time it will deploy 26 Starlink V3 satellites before returning to Starbase for its own ambitious catch attempt.

Satellite visibility in the night sky depends on a cocktail of factors, from the size of the spacecraft to its reflectivity, orbital inclination and position relative to the Earth and sun.

Berdasarkan laporan, "it certainly will be visible in twilight hours. com. It should be very bright, considerably brighter than the Starlink satellites due to its size," professor James Osborn of Durham University told Space. "Where and when is a bit more tricky. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, ship and its starlink satellites may be seen in the 90 minutes directly after sunset on nov. 13 and before sunrise on Nov. 14, as the probes catch the sunlight on either side of Earth's colossal shadow as they drift through the twilight sky.

Diungkapkan bahwa the spacecraft will initially appear as a string of bright, evenly spaced lights, with ship most likely appearing significantly brighter than the starlink satellites. "So it will be best viewed between those latitudes, and then lower in the sky up to latitudes of 40 N and 40 S. 5 [degrees] N and S of the equator," explained Massey. Diungkapkan bahwa magnitude is the scale used by astronomers to measure the brightness of objects in the night sky. The lower the magnitude, the brighter the object! #252. Astronomers discover hidden alien planet in James Webb images

📅 10 Nov 2026

Astronomers discover hidden alien planet in James Webb images

Tanggal: 10 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261108233028.htm

Sebagaimana diketahui, the milky way is believed to contain billions of planets beyond our solar system. These distant worlds, known as exoplanets, offer astronomers an opportunity to explore other planetary systems, identify potentially habitable environments, and perhaps eventually discover evidence of life elsewhere in the universe.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, finding these planets is one challenge. Most exoplanets orbit stars that shine so brightly that the planets become nearly impossible to distinguish from the surrounding glare. Actually seeing them is another. Even the most advanced space telescopes struggle to separate the faint light of a distant planet from the overwhelming brightness of its host star.

Diungkapkan bahwa now, researchers have developed a powerful new method for removing that starlight from telescope images, revealing planets that were previously hidden. The technique uses a sophisticated computer simulation of the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) and has already exposed an exoplanet that was concealed in existing observations. In tests involving known planets, it achieved two to 15 times greater detection sensitivity than conventional approaches.

A Digital Twin of James Webb Reveals Hidden Planets.

Berdasarkan laporan, the breakthrough centers on a virtual replica of webb's near infrared camera (nircam), an instrument designed to observe the universe in infrared light. By recreating how the camera operates, researchers can identify and correct tiny imperfections that interfere with its observations.

Berdasarkan laporan, the virtual model, often called a "digital twin," allows scientists to simulate the telescope's behavior and determine how starlight spreads through its optical system. Once they understand the patterns produced by the star, they can digitally subtract much of that glare, making faint planets easier to detect.

"Directly imaging exoplanets is incredibly challenging because even the tiniest imperfections in a telescope can make it difficult to separate the faint light of a planet from the overwhelming glare of its star," explains Caltech's Katie Bouman, professor of computing and mathematical sciences, electrical engineering and astronomy, a Rosenberg Scholar, and a Heritage Medical Research Institute Investigator, who is a co-author of a Nature paper about the new method published online November 4.

Berdasarkan laporan, "what's exciting is that we're showing how computation can help overcome limitations of the telescope itself," bouman continues. "By combining a physical model of the instrument with optimization techniques from machine learning, we have been able to remove starlight much more precisely, making it easier to detect faint exoplanets and even reveal one that was previously hidden in the JWST data. ".

How Scientists Make Blinding Starlight Disappear.

Berdasarkan laporan, the researchers named their approach physics-based learning for imaging planets (flip). Rather than relying entirely on improvements to telescope hardware, the system uses advanced computation to correct problems in images that have already been collected.

Diungkapkan bahwa to develop flip, the team created a detailed physical model of webb's infrared camera. They then used computational techniques to examine millions of possible imperfections, subtle changes, and other unknown factors that could influence the telescope's observations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, these small variations matter because even an extremely slight distortion can alter how a star appears in an image. When astronomers attempt to remove the star's light, any remaining glare can overwhelm the much dimmer signal from a nearby planet.

Sebagaimana diketahui, by accounting for these effects, flip produces a highly precise model of the star's appearance. Researchers can then subtract that modeled starlight from the original observations, allowing previously obscured objects to become visible.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "this is the first time that we have demonstrated that these little imperfections or instabilities are not a limiting factor in the kinds of planets we can image," says lead author rodrigo ferrer-chavez, a graduate student at northwestern university in the lab of astronomer jason wang, who is also a co-author of the paper. It gets dimmer and very deformed until at the end you get a pretty clean image and, if you're lucky, there's a blob there, which is a glowing planet. "As you go through this iterative process of trying to find what the telescope actually is doing during observations, you basically see the glare of the star disappearing in very bizarre ways. ".

A Failed Experiment Led to a Major Breakthrough.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the idea behind flip began taking shape when ferrer-chavez was an undergraduate student at the autonomous university of yucatán in mexico. He had already participated in a Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship project with Wang, who was then a 51 Pegasi b Postdoctoral Fellow (named after the first exoplanet discovered orbiting a Sun-like star) in the laboratory of Dimitri Mawet.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, mawet is the david morrisroe professor of astronomy at caltech and a senior research scientist at nasa's jet propulsion laboratory, which is managed by caltech. He also serves as director of instrumentation for the Caltech Optical Observatories.

Berdasarkan laporan, at the time, ferrer-chavez was looking for additional opportunities to pursue research. Meanwhile, Wang had been discussing a potential collaboration with Bouman that would combine her expertise in computational imaging with his knowledge of astronomical instruments. Their shared goal was to improve the ability of telescopes to directly image exoplanets.

Diungkapkan bahwa the two researchers brought ferrer-chavez into the project and began mentoring him. However, the initial effort did not produce the results they had hoped for.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "rodrigo's senior thesis was an exploration of possible approaches, none of which ended up being what we did for this paper, but it helped rule out what not to do and also helped us understand the problem better," wang says. "I believe our recent success was only possible because we did that exercise first. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, ferrer-chavez originally attempted to train machine learning models to predict the patterns of starlight appearing in telescope data. That strategy proved unsuccessful, prompting the team to rethink how the technology could be used.

Instead of asking artificial intelligence to predict what the glare should look like, they turned to computational tools developed for machine learning to perform detailed physical calculations.

Diungkapkan bahwa these methods allowed the researchers to adjust millions of variables, much like turning an enormous collection of control knobs. Each adjustment helped refine their simulation of the telescope until it more closely reproduced the actual observations. Performing this many calculations manually would be impractical.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the resulting approach combines the physical laws governing light and telescope optics with the computational power of modern optimization methods. Rather than simply guessing what should be removed from an image, FLIP uses a model of how the telescope produces that image in the first place.

James Webb's Archives May Contain More Hidden Worlds.

One of the most exciting possibilities is that astronomers may not need new telescope observations to benefit from the discovery.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, webb has already collected enormous amounts of astronomical data, including images of stars that could harbor planets too faint to detect using earlier analysis methods. FLIP offers a way to revisit these observations and search for objects that were overlooked.

Diungkapkan bahwa "we now have a tool that lets us discover and study planets that we were not able to 'see' before, even if that planet was already in an image in the jwst archive," ferrer-chavez explains. "We can try to find planets that may have been missed there, and also planets that perhaps we tried to image, but we could not actually detect at the time. ".

This means some planets that were previously considered beyond the reach of direct imaging could potentially be identified without sending another telescope into space.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it also changes how astronomers can think about existing observations. An image that appears to contain nothing but a brilliant star may hold additional information about planets hidden beneath its glare.

Pushing Telescopes Beyond Their Physical Limits.

Sebagaimana diketahui, astronomers have spent decades developing technology to reduce the overwhelming brightness of stars. One important tool is a coronagraph, an instrument designed to block starlight so that faint objects nearby can be observed more clearly.

Diungkapkan bahwa for example, nasa's recently launched nancy grace roman space telescope carries a coronagraph instrument developed by researchers at caltech, jpl, and ipac (a science and data center for astronomy at caltech). The instrument is specifically designed to suppress starlight and improve the direct imaging of exoplanets.

Berdasarkan laporan, but even exceptionally precise telescope hardware has unavoidable limitations. Wang explains that physical instruments alone cannot match the level of correction achieved by FLIP when processing the images.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the james webb space telescope, which we demonstrated on, is optically stable to the nanometer level, which just sounds pretty awesome, but that's still limiting," he says. Because of some very specific design, this technique could be used on any telescope. "We're excited because this technique is not limited specifically to JWST. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, a nanometer is one billionth of a meter, meaning webb's optical system maintains extraordinary precision. Yet even disturbances on this incredibly small scale can interfere with the detection of planets next to bright stars.

Diungkapkan bahwa flip offers a different way around that problem. Instead of requiring the telescope itself to eliminate every tiny imperfection, the technique mathematically accounts for those effects after the observations have been made.

The researchers now intend to refine FLIP and investigate how it could work with additional instruments, including the Roman Space Telescope and telescopes operating from Earth's surface.

A Powerful New Tool in the Search for Another Earth.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the implications may extend well beyond today's observatories. The researchers believe their approach could help shape future space missions, particularly those designed to search for planets resembling Earth.

Sebagaimana diketahui, one major possibility is nasa's proposed habitable worlds observatory (hwo). The mission is intended to become the first telescope specifically designed to search for evidence of life on planets orbiting other stars.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, a central objective would be to photograph earth-like planets within the habitable zones of stars similar to our sun. A habitable zone is the range of distances around a star where temperatures could allow liquid water to exist on a planet's surface, assuming suitable atmospheric conditions.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, but the technical challenge is enormous. An Earth-like planet orbiting a Sun-like star can be approximately 10 billion times fainter than the star itself, making the planet extraordinarily difficult to distinguish from the surrounding light.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the goal of hwo is to find earth-like planets and the habitable zones of sun-like stars through a direct imaging method," ferrer-chavez says. "The engineering challenge of trying to image something that is around 10 billion times fainter than something right next to it is a brutal -- not just to clean the image but to build a telescope that can take that image. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, flip could make that challenge more manageable. If astronomers can digitally remove more unwanted starlight after capturing an image, future telescope designs may not need to overcome every source of optical instability through hardware alone.

The approach could therefore give engineers greater flexibility while allowing astronomers to extract more information from the light their instruments collect.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "i feel we just unlocked a new frontier," wang says. "We've now gone beyond the telescope stability limit for the first time with this new technique, and this new paradigm, I think, can be applied to every instrument that's trying to image exoplanets. ".

Bringing the Search for Alien Life Into Focus.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, for bouman, the long-term ambition is much larger than simply finding more distant planets. Astronomers ultimately hope to obtain direct images of worlds resembling Earth and examine them for possible signs of life.

Berdasarkan laporan, reaching that goal will require major advances in telescope engineering, astronomical instruments, and image processing. But the new research demonstrates that some of the most important improvements may come from better ways of interpreting data rather than building increasingly precise hardware.

Berdasarkan laporan, "there's still a long way to go, but this work shows how much more is possible when we combine advances in telescope technology with computational imaging," bouman says. "Sometimes, the key to seeing something new isn't just building a better instrument but finding a better way to make sense of the light it collects. ".

Sebagaimana diketahui, the findings were published in nature in a paper titled "imaging exoplanets below the telescope stability limit. Feng of MIT, along with Laurent Pueyo and Marshall D. " Additional co-authors include William T. Freeman and Brandon Y. Perrin of the Space Telescope Science Institute in Baltimore.

The research received support from the Space Telescope Science Institute, the Sloan Foundation, an Amazon AI4Science Discovery Award, and the National Science Foundation.

Diungkapkan bahwa wendy's also reported its third-quarter results on thursday. Its same-store sales declined for the seventh straight quarter. However, its quarterly earnings and revenue topped Wall Street's expectations.

Sebagaimana diketahui, shares of wendy's fell less than 1% in morning trading. The takeover offer had lifted the stock, which has lost about 60% of its value over the last three years.

#257. DNA on the Shroud of Turin reveals centuries of hidden secrets

📅 09 Nov 2026

DNA on the Shroud of Turin reveals centuries of hidden secrets

Tanggal: 09 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261108202703.htm

Berdasarkan laporan, scientists have uncovered a remarkable collection of dna hidden within the shroud of turin, revealing a surprisingly complex biological history behind one of the world's most mysterious and controversial religious artifacts. The genetic evidence includes traces of humans, bacteria, fungi, plants, animals, and even Mediterranean red coral, offering new clues about the environments and people that have come into contact with the famous cloth over the centuries.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, published in scientific reports, the study used advanced dna sequencing technology to examine samples collected from the shroud in 1978. For the first time, researchers applied a sophisticated technique (rigorous PCR-free next-generation metagenomic sequencing) to these officially collected samples, allowing them to identify genetic material preserved within the linen fibers in unprecedented detail.

Diungkapkan bahwa unlike traditional dna testing, which often focuses on genetic material from a single organism, metagenomic sequencing can detect dna from many different species within the same sample. This makes it particularly useful for studying historical objects that have been handled, stored, and exposed to changing environments over long periods.

By examining this genetic material, the international research team assembled what they describe as the most comprehensive picture yet of the biological traces accumulated on the Shroud throughout its history.

Human DNA and a Hidden World of Microorganisms.

Berdasarkan laporan, among the discoveries were multiple lineages of human mitochondrial dna, suggesting that genetic material from different human populations has accumulated on the cloth. Mitochondrial DNA is a small portion of our genetic material that is inherited through the maternal line, making it especially useful for studying ancestry and population history.

Berdasarkan laporan, the researchers also identified an unexpectedly diverse microbiome, the collection of microscopic organisms associated with a particular environment or object. These included bacteria commonly found on human skin, various fungi, and microorganisms adapted to living in salty environments.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, some of these organisms belong to a group known as archaea, which are single-celled microorganisms distinct from bacteria. Certain archaea can thrive in extremely salty conditions that would be difficult for many other forms of life to tolerate.

Together, these findings reveal that the Shroud carries a complicated biological record shaped by repeated human contact and exposure to different environmental conditions.

DNA From Plants, Animals, and Mediterranean Coral.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the discoveries extended far beyond human dna and microorganisms. Scientists also detected genetic traces from numerous plant and animal species, adding another layer to the Shroud's biological history.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, plant dna included cultivated wheat, carrots, maize, bananas, and peanuts. Genetic material from domesticated animals was also present, including cattle, pigs, chickens, dogs, and cats.

One particularly unusual finding was DNA associated with Mediterranean red coral.

Diungkapkan bahwa the wide variety of biological material suggests that the cloth has encountered a diverse range of living organisms and environmental influences. These genetic traces may reflect its long history of handling, storage, and movement through different geographical regions.

Berdasarkan laporan, importantly, the presence of dna from a particular species does not establish when that material reached the cloth. Some traces could have accumulated relatively recently, while others may reflect much older interactions. This makes the findings valuable for reconstructing the Shroud's environmental history, but also highlights the difficulty of interpreting DNA recovered from an object that has been exposed to human activity for centuries.

Can DNA Solve the Mystery of the Shroud of Turin?.

Despite the remarkable diversity of genetic material, the researchers emphasize that their findings cannot establish the Shroud's age or authenticity.

Diungkapkan bahwa the shroud of turin is a linen cloth bearing the faint image of a human figure and has long been associated by some believers with the burial of jesus. Its origins have been debated for generations, making it one of the most extensively investigated historical and religious artifacts in the world.

Berdasarkan laporan, because the cloth has been touched and exposed to different environments over many centuries, its dna represents a mixture of biological material accumulated at different times. This makes it impossible to reliably separate any original DNA that might have been associated with the fabric from the many genetic traces deposited afterward.

Berdasarkan laporan, instead, the research demonstrates how modern forensic genomics and proteomics can reveal information that traditional methods might miss. Forensic genomics uses genetic evidence to investigate biological origins and interactions, while proteomics examines proteins, which can also preserve valuable clues about biological materials.

Together, these approaches offer powerful new ways to investigate how historical objects have been preserved, handled, and exposed to different environments.

Modern DNA Technology Reveals New Historical Clues.

Sebagaimana diketahui, professor noemi procopio, professor of forensic science at the university of lancashire, contributed to the international research collaboration. She emphasized that advances in forensic technology are making it possible to recover information from historical samples collected decades earlier.

Professor Noemi Procopio, Professor of Forensic Science at the University of Lancashire, said: "The Shroud of Turin continues to fascinate historians, scientists and the public, and we're thrilled to reveal new information about the biological complexity preserved within samples collected almost 50 years ago by applying new cutting-edge forensic DNA technologies.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, "the shroud represents a rich archive of genetic information that has accumulated over centuries of human interaction and environmental exposure. ".

This Vampire Survivors spin-off has a lot of love for the famous grimdark sci-fi universe, but without the intimidatingly dense lore and complex systems.

Berdasarkan laporan, when you purchase through links on our site, we may earn an affiliate commission. Here’s how it works.

Diungkapkan bahwa we've had no shortage of great warhammer 40k games lately, but most aren't exactly aimed at the casual crowd. Warhammer Survivors changes that, finally providing curious gamers with an easy entry point into the grim darkness of the 41st millennium.

Sebagaimana diketahui, developed by auroch digital (in collaboration with vampire survivors' poncle), this new spin on the survivors-like roguelite subgenre mixes the sci-fi 40,000 setting with the pure fantasy age of sigmar universe. This means heroes and enemies from all over the Warhammer mythos meet together in a bite-sized game that anyone can figure out and enjoy in less than five minutes.

When you look at the alternatives, that's a remarkable achievement for a franchise that's notoriously hard (and often expensive) to get into.

Berdasarkan laporan, warhammer survivors isn't bogged down by dense lore, involved mechanics, or massive campaign playthroughs. It's more of an "inspired by" effort that gives casuals a small taste of the series' iconic characters — including Boltgun's Malum Caedo — and factions like the terrifying Tyranids, the raucous Orks, and the foul forces of Chaos.

All of 40K's (and Age of Sigmar's) recognizable elements are on display, but they serve more as flavoring sprinkled on top of Vampire Survivors' successful formula.

Berdasarkan laporan, if you're new to the survivors-like subgenre, it's a unique gaming experience. You battle an endless onslaught of enemies that slowly march towards you, with your character passively attacking automatically. You only need to move them around sprawling arenas and select level-up upgrades and items after collecting enough gems (skulls in this case).

The moment-to-moment gameplay is as simple as it can get outside of walking sims and interactive "experiences," but there's a deceiving depth to item synergies and how to correctly "build" characters to endure all the carnage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, unlike poncle's original game, warhammer survivors struggles a bit to get going. The early hours are sluggish until you unlock certain meta upgrades, but its still got that Vampire Survivors magic at its core.

Diungkapkan bahwa as far as "podcast/gym games" go, this is a perfect fit. There's just enough going on to keep one's brain engaged, but minimal inputs and a tight overarching design lead to a rhythm that's easy to get into without using much brainpower. It's oddly satisfying to weave through enemies and level up your firepower, watching a single Astra Militarum grunt grow into a full Lasgun-spamming, chainsword-wielding wrecking ball.

Sebagaimana diketahui, achievement and unlock hunters will find enough to bite into here, too. It's unclear if the devs will continue to add more Warhammer 40K and Age of Sigmar deep cuts to this game via DLCs and free updates, but those universes have daunting depths to explore. This really could become a gateway game for future 40K fans: by the time they realize they're hooked, they'll already have 2000 pts of space marines painted and ready to play.

Sebagaimana diketahui, as massive sci-fi and fantasy properties try to aggressively expand and absorb more and more fans, it's easy to pander to already-converted diehards too much. And sure, we can't wait for strategy heavyweights like Dawn of War 4 and Total War: WH40K either, but they're hardly good recommendations for folks who don't even know what a Space Marine is or why the robotic Necrons are so grumpy.

Diungkapkan bahwa warhammer survivors won't answer those questions beyond the surface-level iconography, but it's fun enough to push those curious to dig deeper and embrace the same material in more mature video game genres. and maybe even pick up a few miniatures.

Sebagaimana diketahui, warhammer survivors is now available on pc (steam & gog), ps5, xbox series x/s, nintendo switch 1/2, and mobile (ios & android). It's also playable on Game Pass.

#263. Major Microsoft Outlook Outage Leaves People With Email Jobs Unable to Email

📅 12 Nov 2026

Major Microsoft Outlook Outage Leaves People With Email Jobs Unable to Email

Tanggal: 12 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.wired.com/story/major-microsoft-outlook-outage-hits-365-customers-north-america/

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, it’s not just you. Microsoft’s 365 business and enterprise services suffered a major outage on Thursday, preventing users of its popular cloud suite from accessing their accounts.

Berdasarkan laporan, around 10:40 am et on thursday, microsoft posted on its 365 status page on x that it was “investigating reports of users experiencing issues when accessing or using microsoft teams functionality in north america. ” By just before 1 pm ET, it said it was aware of “issues accessing Exchange Online mailboxes through multiple connection methods in the Americas. ”.

Microsoft later said that its network was also “experiencing elevated load across multiple regions, which is likely contributing to the connectivity errors,” but that the issue was related to servers going offline, not due to increased traffic.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, around an hour later, microsoft said it had “begun redistributing connection traffic across our broader worldwide infrastructure to help balance the load” and was “aggressively pursuing all pathways to reduce impact. ”.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, “we've paused all deployments. We're moving additional traffic off the affected infrastructure, and we're restarting affected servers to return them to service,” Microsoft wrote.

In an update on its status page, Microsoft said impacted services may include Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Copilot 365, and Microsoft Defender XDR.

Sebagaimana diketahui, “we are aware and investigating reports of users experiencing issues with microsoft 365 services, primarily issues with exchange online,” a microsoft spokesperson tells wired in a statement. “We appreciate our customer's patience while we work to restore services as soon as possible. ”.

Outage reports on the service uptime tracking website Downdetector began falling around 1:15 pm ET after a large spike in users reporting issues with Outlook and other Microsoft 365 products around noon.

Sebagaimana diketahui, it is currently unclear when the outage may be over or what its cause may be. In a status update on X posted just before 3 pm ET, Microsoft said “a problem” was “causing servers to fail automated health checks and become unavailable” but that it was attempting to reboot its systems to hopefully bring them back online.

Sebagaimana diketahui, outages in cloud services occur frequently, and their causes can vary. Configuration errors, resolution issues with the Domain Name System, and cyberattacks can all cause connection errors. There is currently no indication that a cyberattack caused the current Microsoft outage.

Sebagaimana diketahui, while major microsoft outages are relatively rare, they are far from unprecedented. In July 2024, a corrupted update from the security firm CrowdStrike caused the “blues screen of death” on Windows machines around the world, while a separate but nearly simultaneous outage knocked out Microsoft Azure services for hours, causing untold millions of dollars in lost revenue due to companies’ inability to function as normal.

Updated 11/12/2026 at 3:05 pm ET: Added comment from Microsoft.

Updated 11/12/2026 at 5:20 pm ET: WIRED updated the article to clarify that the Azure outage was unrelated to the CrowdStrike-related issues with Windows in 2024.

#264. Scientists find deadly virus DNA hidden in 1,000-year-old manuscripts

📅 11 Nov 2026

Scientists find deadly virus DNA hidden in 1,000-year-old manuscripts

Tanggal: 11 Nov 2026 | Sumber: https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261106174545.htm

Berdasarkan laporan, some of europe's most famous medieval manuscripts, including the york gospels, have revealed an extraordinary secret hidden in their pages. Scientists have discovered ancient viral DNA preserved in the animal skins used to make parchment, opening a new window into the 3,500-year history of sheeppox virus (SPPV).

Berdasarkan laporan, the discovery was made by an international research team led by university college dublin (ucd). By analyzing parchment from centuries-old documents, the researchers uncovered the first genetic evidence that this destructive disease was spreading through European sheep flocks long before modern times.

Sebagaimana diketahui, sheeppox is highly contagious and can spread through a flock with alarming speed. It can kill large numbers of infected animals, particularly young sheep, while also causing major economic losses by reducing wool, meat, and milk production.

Ancient Manuscripts Preserve the DNA of Deadly Viruses.

Diungkapkan bahwa published in science advances, the new study reconstructs more than 3,500 years of sheeppox virus evolution. Researchers identified viral DNA in several historically important medieval manuscripts, revealing that documents preserved for their cultural significance can also contain valuable biological evidence.

Diungkapkan bahwa among the manuscripts examined was the 1,000-year-old york gospels, considered one of the finest surviving illuminated manuscripts from the early anglo-saxon period. The researchers also studied older works, including the Corpus Glossary at Corpus Christi College Cambridge, one of the earliest English dictionaries, along with other medieval manuscripts from Britain and continental Europe.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the secret lies in the parchment itself. Before paper became widely available, manuscripts were often produced using carefully prepared animal hides, including skins from sheep, goats, and cattle. These materials can preserve traces of an animal's biological history, including evidence of infections present when it died.

Berdasarkan laporan, in several manuscripts, the researchers detected sheeppox virus dna on multiple pages. These findings indicate that infected animals had supplied some of the skins used to produce the documents.

Sebagaimana diketahui, an especially surprising discovery involved viral dna found on parchment made from calfskin and goatskin. Because sheeppox primarily infects sheep, the results raise two possibilities: the virus may occasionally have infected other livestock species, or viral material may have contaminated the skins during parchment production.

Historic Books Become Unexpected Disease Archives.

Diungkapkan bahwa "the recording of ancient dna of pathogens has completely changed our understanding of infectious disease in the past, and here we show that parchment can also preserve animal pathogen dna. It is possible that archives and libraries around the world also contain the genetic traces of disease outbreaks in animals in the past," said Louis L'Hôte, PhD candidate at UCD and lead author of the study.

Berdasarkan laporan, "these genomes help us understand how these pathogens evolved and how they impacted past societies -- such as sheeppox virus, which we show has been affecting eurasian sheep herds for at least three and a half millennia. ".

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the findings suggest that libraries and archives may hold far more information about historical diseases than previously recognized. Manuscripts that have survived for hundreds of years could provide genetic evidence of livestock outbreaks that left few other records.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "parchment making has been considered a vanishing craft, but we are beginning to understand just how much of the past it has retained. This project shows that parchments not only preserve our cultural history for hundreds of years, but also the landscape of disease in our livestock in the medieval period," said Dr. Kevin G. Daly, Associate Professor at UCD School of Agriculture and Food Science and the study's supervising author.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "this kind of exciting, surprising discovery is only possible when researchers from a range of disciplines come together to share their expertise and data -- a generosity and trust that collaborative science depends on. ".

The project brought together specialists in genetics, history, virology, protein chemistry, and conservation, allowing the team to investigate the manuscripts from both historical and biological perspectives.

Ancient Sheep Teeth Reveal 3,700 Years of Disease.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the medieval manuscripts were only part of the investigation. To trace the disease further into the past, the scientists also examined DNA recovered from sheep teeth dating to the Bronze Age.

Teeth are particularly useful for studying ancient infections because they can protect genetic material for thousands of years, often preserving evidence that has disappeared from other skeletal remains.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the researchers identified the oldest known genetic traces of sheeppox virus in sheep teeth recovered from ancient pastoralist settlements in the eurasian steppe. When combined with the manuscript findings, this evidence shows that the disease has affected livestock for more than 3,700 years.

Sebagaimana diketahui, to investigate how the virus developed, the team compared ancient viral dna with genetic sequences from modern viruses. Their analysis suggests that the main branches of the capripoxvirus family (sheeppox virus, goatpox virus, and lumpy skin disease virus) separated from one another sometime between 11,500 and 3,700 years ago.

Berdasarkan laporan, that estimated timeline coincides with major changes in human history, including the domestication of livestock and the large-scale movement of sheep from the eurasian steppe into europe. These movements may have played an important role in the virus's long history of transmission.

A Deadly Virus That Has Barely Changed in Thousands of Years.

Diungkapkan bahwa one of the study's most striking findings was how little the sheeppox virus has changed genetically over the past several thousand years. Unlike some other viruses, its genome appears to have remained remarkably stable despite its long history of infecting livestock.

Understanding that stability could help scientists identify the genetic changes that originally allowed the virus to become an effective sheep pathogen.

Sebagaimana diketahui, the discovery also has immediate relevance. Sheeppox remains a serious threat to livestock farming, with outbreaks continuing to cause substantial economic damage.

"People around the world are still fighting against this pathogen -- there is currently an outbreak of sheeppox in Greece, causing much economic damage," said Louis L'Hôte.

Sebagaimana diketahui, "ancient genomes can help us understand how these pathogens affecting us today evolved. We find that unlike the smallpox virus, the sheeppox virus genome was very stable over the last few millennia. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, l'hôte added: "this might mean that genetic changes before this point were very important to how the sheeppox virus evolved to infect its host, which may help us fight the pathogen in the future. ".

Berdasarkan laporan, by uncovering viral dna in both medieval manuscripts and prehistoric animal remains, the researchers have demonstrated a powerful new way to investigate the history of infectious diseases. Their work suggests that materials preserved for entirely different purposes may contain valuable clues about the emergence, spread, and evolution of pathogens that continue to affect the world today.

Berdasarkan laporan, the research was funded by taighde éireann-research ireland and the european research council. Led by UCD, the project involved more than 30 institutions in Ireland and internationally, including Trinity College Dublin, the Helmholtz Institute for One Health, Université Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne, the University of Leicester, Cambridge University, and the University of Copenhagen.

Diungkapkan bahwa sometimes the simplest performances have the most to say. “La gente pasa, pero las palabras quedan,” he sang, celebrating language’s enduring power. Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, thank you for visiting nature. To obtain the best experience, we recommend you use a more up to date browser (or turn off compatibility mode in Internet Explorer). Giorgia Guglielmi is a freelance writer in Basel, Switzerland.

Sebagaimana diketahui, both male and female kelp were shown to be capable of reproduction without fertilization. Credit: Madelein_Wolf/Getty.

When potential mates are scarce, some types of seaweed can take reproduction into their own hands, so to speak, according to a study published on 12 November in PLoS Biology1.

“Our findings highlight that kelp are even more flexible in their reproduction than previously appreciated,” says Daniel Liesner, a marine biologist at the GEOMAR Helmholtz Centre for Ocean Research Kiel in Germany.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the brown algae, which provide food and shelter for marine life, “are really weird, they do all kinds of stuff”, says reina veenhof, an ecologist at the scottish association for marine science in oban, uk. What’s interesting about the study is that it helps to explain how changes in gene activity allow kelp to reproduce in different ways, she says.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, scientists know that kelp can reproduce asexually, with unfertilized eggs developing into offspring. This process was even documented for one male strain2 — the PLoS Biology study shows that this wasn’t a one-off.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, the ability of male reproductive cells to develop without fertilization is striking, says olivier de clerck, a seaweed biologist at ghent university in belgium. This is because, unlike eggs, sperm cells are small and have few resources to support development.

Diungkapkan bahwa the researchers focused on laminaria pallida, a species found along the atlantic coasts of south africa and namibia. In the wild, 523 individual kelp showed no clear evidence of asexual reproduction.

Dalam perkembangan terbarunya, by contrast, both microscopic male and female l. pallida grown in separate laboratory dishes could produce offspring without fertilization. During asexual reproduction, the gene expression in males changed, making them more similar to females.

However, when they were lab-grown in the presence of a member of the opposite sex, kelp favoured sexual reproduction, suggesting they can detect nearby partners through chemical signals.
